niyt vshyenm mtu lovehi dnndduvmtt biy vnnnhtt ehi sNjnyaavk aet. ey jnyaa ek raes krnu lbn dinyki. tvd ey saakssi pvsnu lbn dinyki.

tvd niyt vshyenm saaem kenekuttm ovungee kriyaavntt numbgee prmaadhipti ovuntt puurnn v (prtiphl) denu aet. niyt vshyenm ohu ovun krn daae pillibnd v abhijnyaanvnty.

in psu v drunnu (saagtyen spiri vuu vsr) htk paeminneyi. numblaa ee sndhaa (dhaany aturin) per suudaanm kll daae anubhv krnu aet. nmut numblaa gbddaa krn daeyin svlpyk mis.
in psu v vsrk paeminneyi. jnyaa ehi vrssaaven aashirvaad krnu lbnu atr tvd ovuhu ehi (plturu) yuss perti.

'ohu maa vet gen enu' yaeyi rjtem paevsiiy. nmut duutyaa ohu(yuusuf) vet paeminni klhi 'ob obee svaamiyaa vet haerii gos tm at kpaa gt kaantaavngee tttvy kumk daeyi ohugen vimsnu. niyt vshyenm maagee prmaadhipti ovungee upaay pillibnd srv jnyaaniiy' yaeyi paevsuveey.

'numblaa yuusuf polmbvaa gnntt taet kll avsthaavee numblaatt kumk vii dae'yi (rju) vimsuveey. 'allaahgen aarkssaav ptmu. ohu gaen kisidu ayhptk api nodnimu' yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy. 'daen styy paehaedili viy. ohu v (kaamyee vrdvaa haesirenntt) taet kllee mmyi. tvd niyt vshyenm ohu styvaadiin aturini' yaeyi asiisgee biriy paevsuvaay.
ey(tt heetuv, ohu) nomaeti taen mm ohu(asiis)tt droohikm nokll bvttt, saebaevinm allaah droohikm krnnngee kumntrnn vltt mg nopenvn bvt, ohu daen gnu pinnisy.

maa gaen mm nirdoossi yaeyi nopvsmi. aatmy pv kiriimtt daeddi les polmbvnnki. nmut maagee prmaadhipti aashirvaad kll daae(aatmy) haer. niyt vshyenm maagee prmaadhipti ati kssmaashiiliiy. mhaa krunnaa gunnyen yukty (yaeyi asiisgee birind paevsuvaay.)

maagee visheess keneku les maa ohu v pt kr gaeniimtt maa vettt ohu v gen enu yaeyi rju paevsuveey. rju ohu smg kthaa kll vitt "niyt vshyenm ob ad din ap atr vishvaasniiytvyk aeti keneki" yaeyi (rju) paevsuveey.
mihitlyee smpt sndhaa ob maa pt krnu. niyt vshyenm mm mnaa daenumaeti aarksskyeki yaeyi (yuusuf) kiiy.
eles api yuusuftt em deeshyee ohu kaemti pridi ehi pdiNci vnntt idd slsaa dunimu. tvd api abhimt krn aytt apgee krunnaav tullin pirinmnnemu. daehaemiyngee prtiphl api nissphl nokrnnemu.
(styy) vishvaas kllvuntt mtu lov prtiphl utumy. tvd ovuhu biy haenngiimen kttyutu krnnn vuuh.
tvd yuusufgee shoodryoo paeminn ohu vet aetullu vuuh. evitt ovun ohu v naandunnnn lesin sittiy d ohu (yuusuf) ovun v hndunaa gtteey.

ovuntt suudaanm kr diy yutu daae ovuntt ohu (yuusuf visin) suudaanm kr dii ( ovun pitttv yn klhi) numblaagee piyaagen vuu numblaagee shoodryaa maa vet gen enu. niyt vshyenm mm kirum puurnn v den bvt, stkaaryin aturin mm shreesstthyeku vn bvt numblaa duttuvaa novee daeyi pvsaa sittiiy.
eheyin numblaa maa vet ohu nogenaavehu nm maa vetin aeti (dhny vlin) numblaatt kisidu kirumk nomaet. tvd numblaa maa vet smiip novnu.
ohu(v kaettuvaa gen eem) gaen apgee piyaannntt api sael krnnemu. tvd niyt vshyenm ap ey sidu krnnoomy yaeyi ovuhu paevsuuh.
ovungee bhaanndd ovungee gmn mlu vlm tbnu. ovun ovungee pvul vet haerii giy vitt ovun ey daen, naevt haerii aa haeki vnu pinnis yaeyi ohu ohugee seevkyintt kiiy.

ovun ovungee piyaannn vet naevt giy klhi apgee piyaannni, (min idiriytt dhaany) kiraa diim ap vet vllkvn ldii. ebaevin ap smg apgee shoodryaa evnu. api (dhaany) kiraa gnnemu. tvd niyt vshyenm api ohu v aarkssaa krnnn vemu yaeyi ovuhu paevsuuh.

miitt per numblaagee shoodryaa (yuusuf) vissyyehi numblaa v mm vishvaas kllaak men mis mohu kerehi d numblaa v mm vishvaas kll yutu d? eheyin aarksskyaa vshyen allaah ati shreesstthy. tvd ohu krunnaavntyingen mhaa krunnaavntyaa y.

ovungee mlu ovuhu vivRt kll klhi ovun vet aapsu den ld ovungee bhaanndd ovuhu duttuvooy. apgee piyaannni, mey api nopaetuvemu, apgee mem bhaanndd aptt naevt den ldii. tvd api apgee pvultt aahaar spynnemu. tvd apgee shoodryaav raek blaa gnnemu. ottu (mt pttvn) brtt api adhik v lbaa gnnemu. ey phsu kirum brki yaeyi paevsuvooy.

mohu v maa vet (naevt) gen en bvtt allaah vetin numblaa mtt prtijnyaavk den tek mm ohu v numblaa smg kisivittek noyvmi. nmut numblaatt (ym npurk) vtt kr gnu laebuvot mis yaeyi ohu paevsiiy. eheyin ovungee prtijnyaav ovuhu ohutt dun klhi ap pvsn daae kerehi allaah bhaarkru yaeyi ohu kiiveey.

maagee druvni, numblaa ekm dorttuvkin aetullu novnu. vividh dorttu vlin aetullu vnu. allaahgen vuu kisivkin numblaa sndhaa kisidu phlk maa visin lbaa diy nohaek. tiinduv allaah stu v mis naet. ohu vet mm bhaar kllemi. tvd bhaar krnnn d ohu vetm bhaar kll yutuy.

tvd ovungee piyaa ovuntt ann kll pridi ovun aetullu vuu klhi yHkuubgee mns tull tibuu abhilaassy ittu viim mis vent kisivk allaahgen ovuntt pryoojny gen dennk noviiy. niyt vshyenm api ohutt igaen vuu daae pillibnd v ohu daenumaetteki. enmut jnyaa aturin bhutryk denaa (ee bv) nodniti.
ovuhu yuusuf vet aetullu vuu klhi ohu tm shoodryaa v llN kr gen niyt vshyenm mm obee shoodryaa vemi. ebaevin ovun sidu krmin sittin daae pillibndv numb duk novnu yaeyi paevsuveey.

ovuntt suudaanm kr diy yutu daae ovuntt suudaanm kr dun klhi tm shoodryaagee gmn mlu v tull jl bndun tbnntt ohu saelaessuveey. psu v ahoo tvlm kruvni, niyt vshyenm numblaa sorun yaeyi niveedkyku dnvaa sittiyeey.
ovuhu ovun vet haerii numblaa naeti kr gttee kumk daeyi vimsuvooy.
rjugee rn kuslaany (bndun) api ahimi kr gttemu. tvd ey gen ennaatt ottuveku brtt (dhaany) aet. tvd ee gaen mm shtik vemi yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy.
allaah mt divuraa pvsmu. mhpollovee klhkm kiriimtt api nopaeminni bvt api sorun novn bvt saebaevinm numblaa dnnehu yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy.
esee nm numblaa borukaaryin vii nm numblaagee prtivipaaky kumk viy yutu daeyi ovuhu vimsuvooy.
ehi prtivipaaky, enm kvrekugee gmn mllehi ey soyaa gnu lbnnee d evitt ohumy ehi prtivipaaky vindiy yuttee. api apraadhkruvntt prtivipaak lbaa denuyee elesy yaeyi ovuhu paevsuuh.

tm shoodryaagee podiytt per ovungee podi vlin (soynntt) pttn gtteey. psu v tm shoodryaagee podiyen ey elliytt gtteey. elesy api yuusuftt (siyll) saelsum kllee. allaahgee kaemaetten tor v, rjugee niitiy tull ohugee shoodryaa gaeniimtt sudusu noviiy. api abhimt krn aytt traatirm uss krnnemu. tvd daenumaeti siyllntt vddaa ihllin mnaa daenumaettku aet.

ohu sorkm kr aetnm (pudumyk novee.) miitt per ohugeem shoodryaa sorkm kr aet yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy. nmut yuusuf ey ovuntt helli nokr ohugee mns tull ey snngvaa gtteey. numblaa sthaanyen npurum ay veti. tvd numblaa vrnnnaa krmin pvsn daae pillibnd v allaah maenvin dnnaay yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.
ahoo utumaannni, saebaevinm mohutt itaa vys gt piyeku sittiyi. ebaevin ohugee taentt ap aturin keneku gnu. niyt vshyenm api ob v daehaemiyn aturin keneku les dkinnemu yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy.
apgee bhaanndd kvurun vetin api soyaa gttemu d ohu haer (vent keneku) ap gaeniimen allaah aarkssaa krtvaa, evitt api niyt vshyenm apraadhkruvn vemu yaeyi ohu paevsuveey.

ohu gaen ovuhu blaaporottu sun vuu klhi rhsin saakcchaa kiriimtt ven v giyooy. niyt vshyenm numblaagee piyaa allaahgen vuu prtijnyaavk numblaa vetin gt saettit miitt per yuusuf vissyehi (evn prtijnyaavk) numblaa kdd kll saettit numblaa nodnnehud? eheyin maagee piyaa maa htt avsr den tek hoo allaah mtt tiindu den tek hoo mm mem bhuumiyen ivt noymi. tvd ohu tiindu dennngen ati shreesstthy yaeyi ovun aturin vaeddimlaa paevsuveey.

numblaa numblaagee piyaa vet aapsu gos apgee piyaannni, niyt vshyenm obee putaa sorkm klleey. ap dnnaa daae pillibnd v mis api saakssi nodrnnemu. tvd api (aptt) nopenen daae aarkssaa krnnn les nosittiyemu yaeyi numblaa pvsnu.
api ehi sitti gmmaanyen haa ehi api munngaesunnu nddyen numb vimsaa blnu. tvd niyt vshyenm api styvaadiihumy.

nmut (miitt per) numblaagee aatmaavn numblaatt krunnk alNkaarvt klleey. eheyin alNkaar ivsiimki (vddaat shreesstth vnuyee.) ovun siyll maa vet gen eemtt allaahtt haekiy. niyt vshyenm ohu srv jnyaanii siyum jnyaany aettaay yaeyi ohu(piyaa) paevsiiy.
tvd ohu ovungen haerii ahoo yuusuf kerehi tibuu maagee shookyee trm yaeyi paevsiiy. tvd duken ohugee daaes sudumaeli viy. ohu (duk) yttpt kr gtteey.
allaah mt divuraa pvsnnemu. ob roogaaturu vn tek hoo vinaash vii ynnn aturin vn tek hoo ob yuusufgee mtkyen ivt novnnee my yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy.
maagee shooky haa maagee duk pillibnd mm paeminnili krnuyee allaah vetmy. tvd numblaa nodnnaa daae mm allaahgen daen gnimi yaeyi ohu paevsuveey.

ahoo maagee druvni, numblaa gos yuusuf haa ohugee shoodryaa pillibnd soyaa blnu. allaahgee dyaav pillibnd v numblaa blaaporottu sun kr nognu. niyt vshyenm prtiksseep krn jnyaa mis vent kisivku allaahgee dyaav pillibnd blaaporottu sun kr nogniti.

ohu vet ovun aetullu vuu klhi ahoo paalktumnni!, ap haa apgee pvultt viptk sidu vii aet. api alp vttinaakmin yut bhaanndd smg paeminn aettemu. ebaevin kirum br aptt puurnn v lbaa dii tvd ap htt (tvt vaeddiyen) dn denu. niyt vshyenm allaah dn dennnhtt kusl pirinmnu aet yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy.
numblaa nodnnaa kmin sitti avsthaavee yuusuf haa ohugee shoodryaatt numblaa kll daae numblaa dnnehu daeyi ohu vimsuveey

saebaevinm ob d yuusuf? yaeyi ovuhu vimsuvooy. mm yuusuf, mee maagee shoodryaay. allaah ap vet aashirvaad klleey. niyt vshyenm krunn nm kvreku allaahtt biy baetimt vii ivsiimen kttyutu krnnee d niyt vshyenm allaah daehaemiyngee kuliy nissphl nokrnu aetaeyi ohu paevsuveey.
allaah mt divurmu. tvd niyt vshyenm api vaerdi krnnn les sittiyd allaah aptt vddaa ob v uss klleey yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy.
ad din numblaa kerehi kisidu dosk naet. allaah numblaatt smaav denu aet. tvd ohu krunnaavntyingen mhaa krunnaavnty yaeyi ohu paevsuveey.
numblaa mee maagee kmisy gen gos maagee piyaagee muhunn mt dmnu. ohutt baelm enu aet. tvd numblaagee pvulee siylu ay maa vet gen enu.
em nddy (misryen) pittt v giy klhi, ovungee piyaa (mesee) paevaesuveey. niyt vshyenm mtt yuusufgee suvnd daeneyi. numblaa mtt dos naegiy yutu novee daeyi ovungee piyaa vimsuveey.
allaah mt divurmin niyt vshyenm ob (tvmt) obee paernni mullaavehim psuvnnehi yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy.

psu v shubhaarNci dnvnnaa paeminni klhi ohu ohugee muhunntt ey daemuveey. evitt ohu naevt peniim aetteku les pt viy. numblaa nodnnaa daae mm allaahgen daen gnimi yaeyi numblaatt mm nokiivemdaeyi ohu vimsuveey.
apgee piyaannni, apgee paapyn vltt ob ap venuven smaav ayaed sittinu maenv.niyt vshyenm api vaerdi krnnn vuuyemu yaeyi ovuhu paevsuvooy.
mm maagee prmaadhiptigen numblaa venuven mtu smaav ayaedimi. niyt vshyen m ohu atikssmaashiilii mhaa krunnaavnty.
ovun yuusuf vet pivisunu klhi tmn vet tm demaapiyn ohu llN kr gtteey. tvd allaah abhimt kllee nm surkssityin lesin numblaa misrytt aetullu vnu yaeyi ohu paevsuveey.

tvd ohu ohugee demaapiyn raajaasaany mt osvaa taebuveey. tvd ovuhu ohutt ( per paevaeti caaritrytt anuv) sujuud krmin his naemuuh. tvd maagee piyaannni, miitt per (maa duttu) maagee sihinyee ythaarthy meyyi. maagee prmaadhipti ey saebaae lesinm aeti klleey. sirgeyin maa baehaer krn vitt d maa atr haa maagee shoodryin atr sseyitaan klhkm aeti kiriimen psu pittisr gmmaanyen numblaa v gen aa vittd ohu maa smg yhpt ayurin kttyutu klleey. niyt vshyenm maagee prmaadhipti ohu abhimt krn daaett krunnaav dkvnnaav. niyt vshyenm srvjnyaanii siyum jnyaany aettaa ohumy.

maagee prmaadhiptiyaanneni, ob mtt raajyy pirinaemuvehiy. tvd siduviim vl ythaarthy igaenvuuvehiy. ahs haa pollovee nirmaapkyaanneni, melov haa mtu lovehi maagee bhaarkru oby. maa (obtt) avnt vnneku lesin mrnnytt pt krnu maenv tvd daehaemiyn smg maa ek krnu maenv ( ynuven ohu praarthnaa klleey.)
(nbivry,) mey adRssymaan puvt aturini. ey api numb vet dnvmu. ovuhu kumntrnny krmin ovungee vissyy sndhaa ek raes vuu avsthaavee numb ovun abiys noviiy.
tvd numb (ovungee vishvaasy gaen ketrm) apeekssaa kll d jnyaa aturin bhutryk denaa deev vishvaasvntyin novee.
mee sndhaa numb kisidu kuliyk ovungen noptnnehiy. mey loovaesiyntt menehi kiriimk mis naet.
ahshi haa mhpollovee ketrm nm saadhk vii d? nmut ovuhu ee gaen pittupaamiin ee hrhaa gmn krti.
ovungen bhutryk denaa, ovun aadeesh krnnn mis allaah v vishvaas nokrti.
allaahgee dnndduvmin vellaagnnaa vuu vysnyk ovun vet paeminniim gaen hoo ovuhu haenngiimkin torv sittiy dii hdisiyeem prmaant mohot paeminniim gaen hoo ovun abhydaayii v sittinnoo d?
mey maagee maargyyi. allaah vet mm aeryum krmi. maa haa maa anugmny kllvun paehaedili saadhk mt sittimu. tvd allaah supivituruy. mm aadeesh krnnn aturin keneku novemi yaeyi numb pvsnu.

(nbivry) numbtt per (vividh gm pllaatvltt) pnnividdkruvn (rsuulvrun) les ap visin vhii (deev vdn) phlkrn ld siyllnm pirimin les haa em ngrvltt ayt pirisk vuuh. ovuhu mhpollovehi saerisraa adhiikssnny kr noblnnood? esee kllee nm ovuntt per sittiyvungee avsaany kesee vii daeyi ovuntt daekgt haekiv tibunni. biy baetimt aytt avsn nivhn utumy. numblaa vtthaa nognnehu d?

rsuulvrun blaaporottu sun vuu vitt niyt vshyenm tmn boru krnu laebuu bv situuh. (evitt) apgee upkaary ovun vet paeminniyeey. ap abhimt krn ay v mudvaa gnu laebiiy. apgee dnndduvm vaerdikaar jnyaagen vllkvnu nolaebee.

saebaevinm ovungee ktaa vstu vl buddhiy aettvuntt paaddmk viy. ey gotnu laebuu ktaavk noviiy. enmut ovun atr aeti daae thvuru krnnk d siylu daae vistr krnnk d vishvaas krn jnyaatt mg penviimk haa dyaavk d viy.
alif, laam, raa. mey deev grnthyee vdn vee. numbgee prmaadhipti vetin numb vet phll krnu laebuu daae styyki. enmut jnyaa aturin bhutryk denaa vishvaas nokrti.

kisidu kulunkin tor v ob dkin ahs osvaa taebuvee allaah vn ohuy. psu v ohu raajaasny mt sthaapit vuuyeey. ohu hiru haa sndu vsnng klleey. siyll niymit kaalyk dkvaa gmn kryi. ohu siylu krunnu saelsum kryi. numblaagee prmaadhiptigee hmu v numblaa tryee vishvaas kll haeki vnu pinnis mem vdn ohu paehaedili kryi.

mhpollov dig haer ehi kndu haa gNgaa aeti kllee ohumy. tvd saaem phl vgaavkinm ehi ohu dvitv vshyen jooddud aeti klleey. tvd ohu dhvl raatriyen aavrnny kryi. niyt vshyenm vtthaa gnnaa jnyaatt mehi saadhk aet.

mhpollovee ekinektt yaabd v pihitti klaap d midi vlin yut uyn d ket vtu d atu shit haa atu rhit rttindi gs d aet.ee siyllttm ek aakaaryee jly spynu laebee. anubhv kiriimeedii eevaayin aetaem dee aetaem deett vddaa vishissttvt kllemu. niyt vshyenm mehi vtthaa gnnaa jnyaatt sNjnyaavn aet.

(ovun tul vishvaasyk naet ynuven nbivry) numb pudumytt pt vnnehi nm ovuhu "api ps bvtt pt vuu vitt nv maeviimk tulltt pt vnnemu d?" yaeyi paevaesiim (miittvddaa) pudumyk vee.tm prmaadhipti v prtiksseep kllvun movuhumy. (ebaevin mrnnin mtuvtt) ovungee gelvl vl vilNgu aettoo d movuhumy. tvd niraavaasiihu d movuhumy. ovuhu ehi sdaatnikyoo veti.

tvd yhpttt per npur ikmn krnnaeyi ovuhu numbgen illaa sittiti. ovuntt per dnndduvmtt lk vuuvn ikut v gos aet. tvd niyt vshyenm numbgee prmaadhipti jnyaa krn apraadh vltt ovuntt kssmaashiiliibhaavyen yukty. emenm niyt vshyenm numbgee prmaadhipti dnndduvm diimehi itaa daeddiy.
tvd ohugee prmaadhiptigen sNjnyaavk ohu vet phll krnu laebiy yutu novee daeyi prtiksseep kllvun pvsti. (nbivry) numb avvaad krnneku pmnni. saaem smuuhykttm mg penvnneku viy.
saaem ktkm usuln daae d grbhaassyee addu vn daae d ehi vaeddi vn daae d allaah dnii. tvd saaem deykm ohu abiys niymit prmaannyk anuv pihittyi.
ohu (allaah) adRssymaan daae haa dRssymaan daae (mnaav) dnnaay. ati mht ati uttriitry.
numblaa aturin prkaashy snngvnnaa d ey helli krnnaa d tvd raatriyehi saenngvennaa d dhvl kaalyee saerisrnnaa d (allaah idiriyee) ek smaany.

ohu idiriyen haa ohu psupsin sitt allaahgee niyoogyen ohu v aarkssaa krn luhubndinnn ohutt veti. ovun tull aeti daae ovun vens kr gnnaa tek niyt vshyenm allaah pirisk tull aeti daae vens nokryi. ym pirisktt allaah ym npurk apeekssaa kllee nm evitt ohutt vaellkiimk nomaet. tvd ohugen tor v vent kisidu bhaarkruvku d ovuntt nomaet.
ohu vnaahi biyk haa (vaesi) blaaporottuvk lesin viduli kettiim numblaatt penvnnaay. tvd ohu ghn vlaakullu nirmaanny kryi.

gigurum ohugee prshNsaav tullin d tvd mlkvrun ohu gaen vuu biyen d (ohu v) pivituru krti. ohu akunnu saer evnu aet. evitt allaah gaen ovun trk krmin sittiy dii ohu emgin abhimt krn aytt vipaaky aeti kryi. tvd ohu upkrmshiilitvyen itaa daeddiy.

saebaae praarthnaav ohuttm stuvee. tvd ohugen tor v ovun ayaed sittinnn visin ovuntt kisivkin prticaar nodkvti. ey (keseed yt) tm ktttt jly llnngaa krviimtt tm daaet jlytt digu krnneku men mis naet. ey ohu vet llnngaa vnnk novee. tvd deev prtiksseepkyingee ayaedum mullaavk mis naet.
ahshi haa mhpollovee aeti daae kaemaetten vuv d akmaetten vuv d allaahttm sujuud krti. ovungee hevnnaeli d udee haa hvs (sujuud krti.)

ahshi haa mhpollovee prmaadhiptiyaannn kvurundae?yi numb vimsnu. allaah yaeyi numb pvsnu. allaahgen tor v tmn vet kisidu pryoojnyk hoo hiNsaavk hoo kiriimtt himikm nodrn bhaarkruvn numblaa gttehu daeyi numb vimsnu. andhyaa haa penumaettaa ek smaan veevid? emenm andhkaaryn haa aalooky ek smaan veevi dae?yi numb vimsnu. esee naethot ohu mvnvaak men ovund mvaa em maeviim ovuntt gllpaa gnnaa hvulkruvn allaahtt aadeesh vshyen ovun tbnnood? siylu daaehi maevumkru allaah yaeyi d tvd ohu eekiiyy yaeyi d (siyll) maedd pvtvnnaa yaeyi d pvsnu.

ohu ahsin jly phll klleey. evitt aelldoll ehi prmaannytt anuv glaa yyi. em gNvtur (iitt) ihllin pihittn penn pinnddu usulyi. tvd aabhrnn haa bhaanndd soymin ginnehi ovun eevaa unnu krn daeyin d ee haa smaan penn pinnddu aet. melesy allaah styy haa astyytt upmaa krnuyee. enm penn pinnddu vuu klii ey turn vii yyi. nmut minisaatt pryoojny gen den daae vuu klii ey mhpollovee raendeyi. elesy allaah upmaavn gen haer paanuyee.

tm prmaadhiptigen prticaar paetuuvntt yhpt daae tibee. ohugen pillituru nopaetuuvn niyt vshyenm ovuntt mhpollovee aeti siylu daae d ee smgm ee haa smaanyk d vii nm ovuhu ey (siyll) vndi vshyen denu aet. npuru vinishcyk aettoo ovuhumy. tvd ovun laegum gnnaa sthaany niryyi. em nvaataen npuru viy.
numbgee prmaadhiptigen numb vet phll krnu laebuu daae styykm bv daen gnnaa, ( mem sty nodaen sittin) andhyaa men vuu ohu vaeni d? niyt vshyenm updes lbnuyee buddhiy aettny.

obee aesipiy ob vet llnngaa viimtt mtten mm ey ob vet gen ennemi yaeyi deev grnthy pillibnd jnyaany aetteku paevsiiy. tm asl ey tibenu ohu duttu klhi "mm gunngruk vnnem d esee naethot gunnmku vnnem daeyi maa priikssaa krnu pinnis, mey maagee prmaadhiptiyaagen vuu bhaagyyki" yaeyi (suleyimaan) paevsiiy. tvd kvreku gunngruk vuuyee d esee gunngruk vnuyee tmn venuvenmy. tvd kvrek gunnmku vuuyee d evitt niyt vshyenm maagee prmaadhipti avshytaavngen tor vuu upkaarshiiliiy. (yn vg daen gt yutuy.)

aeygee raajaasny aeytt hndunaa gt nohaeki bvtt numblaa pt krnu. aey ee gaen nivaerdi v hndunaa gnnii d esee naethot nivraedi v hndunaa nognnvun aturin vnnii dae?yi api blmu yaeyi ohu (suleyimaan) paevsiiy.

psu v aey paeminni klhi obgee raajaasny meles daeyi vimsnu laebiiy. aey niyt vshyenm mey eymy yaeyi (raejinn) paevsuvaay. tvd eytt per ap vet jnyaany denu laebuvemu. tvd api avnt vnnn (muslimvrun) vuuyemu.
allaahgen tor v aey nmdimin sitti daae aey v vaellaekviiy. niyt vshyenm aey deviyn prtiksseep kll jnyaa aturin keneku viy.

ob maaligaavtt aetullu vnu yaeyi aeytt kiynu laebiiy. aey ey duttu vitt jlyen pirunnu tttaakyk yaeyi situvaay. aey aeygee vstry aeygee kennddyen ivttt (osvaa) gttaay. niyt vshyenm mey pllinnguvlin musu vuu maaligaavk yaeyi ohu (suleyimaan) paevsiiy. maagee prmaadhiptiyaanneni, niyt vshyenm mm mtt m apraadh kr gttemi. tvd mm suleyimaan smg srv lookynhi himipaannn vuu allaahtt avnt vuuyemi yaeyi aey paevsuvaay.
tvd numblaa allaahtt naemndum krnu yaeyi (niyoog krmin) saebaevinm api smuud jnyaa vet ovungee shoodr saalih v evvemu. evitt ovuhu vaad krgnnaa depirisk vuuh.
maagee jnyini, yhkmtt per paapkm soynntt numblaa ikmn vnuyee aeyi? numblaa krunnaa krnu lbnu pinnis numblaa allaahgen smaav ayaed sittiy yutu novee daeyi ohu paevsiiy.
numb haa numb smg vuuvn aptt asub per nimittki yaeyi ovuhu paevsuuh. numblaagee asubvaady allaah vetini. nmut numblaa priikssnnytt bhaajny krnu lbn piriski yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.
mhpollovee klhkm krn emenm vidhimt nokrn knnddaaym nvyk em ngryee viy.

niyt vshyenm ohu haa ohugee pvul api raatriyee mraa dmmu. psu v ohugee pvulee vinaashy api noduttuvemu yaeyi d niyt vshyenm api styaavaadiihu yaeyi d ohugee bhaarkrutt pvsnnemu yaeyi ovuhu (em knnddaaym) paevsuuh.
ovuhu kumntrnnykin kumntrnny kllooy. ap d ovun nodaen sittiy dii kumntrnnykin kumntrnny kllemu.
ovungee kumntrnnyee avsaany kesee vii daeyi ob maenvin blnu. niyt vshyenm api ovun haa ovungee jnyaa siylu denaa vinaash kr daemuvemu.
ovun kll apraadhkm heetuven graa vaettunnu ovungee nives meevaa y. niyt vshyenm mehi daenmutukm lbn jnyaatt saadhkyk aet.
tvd vishvaas kr biy baetimt vii sittiyvun api mudvaa gttemu.
tvd luut d (api evvemu.) ohu tm jnyaa vet numblaa daek daekm striin haer purussyin vet paeminnennehu dae?yi vimsuu avsthaav sihiytt ngnu.
kaantaavn haer dmaa, kaamaashaaven yutu v pirimin vet numblaa paeminnennehu d? numblaa ajnyaan piriski.
numblaa luutgee prpur numblaagee deeshyen pittuvhl krnu. niyt vshyenm ovun piviturukm ptn jn piriski, yaeyi paevsiim mis ohugee jnyaagee pillitur venekk noviiy.
evitt api ohu haa ohugee pvulee ay mudvaa gttemu. ohugee biriy haer. aey raendii sittinnn atrtt pt kllemu.
tvd api ovun vet vrssaavk ptit kllemu. avvaad krnu laebuuvngee vrssaav npuru viy.
pvsnu. siylu prshNsaa allaahtty. tvd ohu tooraa gt ohugee gaettn kerehi shaantiy at veevaa. shreesstth vnuyee allaah d esee naethot ovun aadeesh krn daae d?

(utum vnuyee ovun aadeesh tbn daae d) esee naethot ahs haa mhpollov mvaa ahsin numblaatt jly phll kll ay d? emgin api saarvt bvin yukt vtuyaayn htt gaenvuuyemu. ehi gs htt gaenviimtt numblaatt (bly) nomaet. allaah smg tvt deviyku sittii d? nmut ovun (allaahtt) smaan krn piriski.
esee naethot mhpollov vaassthaanyk bvtt pt kott ee atr gNgaavn aeti kott ehi kndu aeti kott muhudu dek atr baadhkyk aeti kll ay d? allaah smg tvt deviyku sittii d? nmut ovungen bhutryk denaa nodniti.

esee naethot krdryk paettlunnu ay ohugen praarthnaa kll vitt ohutt pillituru dii em npur ivt krnnaa d? tvd, ohu numblaa mhpollovee niyoojityin bvtt pt kryi. allaah smg tvt deviyku sittii d? numblaa menehi krnuyee suph vshyeni.

esee naethot pollovee haa muhudee andhkaarynhi numblaatt mg penvnnaa d? tvd tm krunnaav atrin sullnng subaashiNsnyk vshyen evnuyee kvrek d? allaah smg tvt deviyku sittii d? ovun aadeesh krn daeyin allaah uttriitry.

esee naethot, (puurvaadrshykin tor v) maeviim nirmaanny kott (ey mrnnytt pt vuu) psu v ylli ( praanny dii) gen ennaa d? ahshi haa mhpollovee numblaatt poossnny lbaa denuyee kvrek d? allaah smg tvt deviyku sittii d? numblaa styvaadiihu nm numblaagee saadhk gen enu.
(nbivry) allaah haer ahshi haa mhpollovee sittinnn adRshymaan daae nodnii yaeyi ob pvsnu. tvd ovun ylli naegittuvnu lbnnee kvdaadaeyi d ovuhu nodniti.
esee nov ovungee daenum mtu lov vettt llnngaa veyi. nmut ovun ee gaen saekyehiy. nmut ovun ee gaen andhbhaavyen pelleti.
ap haa apgee mutun mittn ps bvtt pt v sittiydii niyt vshyenm api baehaer krnu lbnnn vnnemu daeyi deviyn prtiksseep kllvun pvsaa sittiyeey.
miitt perd ap haa apgee mutun mittn mee gaen prtijnyaa denu laebuvemu. mey paeraennnngee prbndhyn mis naet.
mhpollovee numblaa gmn kr vaerdikruvngee avsaany kesee vii daeyi avdhaanyen blnu yaeyi ob pvsnu.
ovun kerehi ob duk novnu. tvd ovun krn kumntrnn heetuven ob ashnkaarii tttvytt pt novnu.
numblaa styvaadiihu nm mem prtijnyaav kvdaadae?yi ovuhu vimsti.
(nbivry) numblaa ikmnin ptn daeyin smhrk numblaatt smiip vnntt pulluvn yaeyi ob pvsnu.
tvd niyt vshyenm obgee prmaadhipti jnyaa vet anugrhshiiliiy. enmut ovungen bhutryk denaa kRtveedii noveti.
tvd ovungee hdvt snngvn daae d ovun helli krn daae d niyt vshyenm obee prmaadhipti dnneey.
tvd ahshi haa mhpollovee saenng vii pvtin kisivk hoo paehaedili leekhnyee sndhn v mis naet.
kvr vissyk gaen ovuhu mtbheed aeti kr gttoo d eevaayin bohoomyk gaen niyt vshyenm israaiil druvntt mem al kuraany vistr kryi.
tvd niyt vshyenm (al kuraany vn) mey mg penviimki. deviyn vishvaas krnnn htt dyaavki.
niyt vshyenm obee prmaadhipti tm niitiy anuv ovun atr tiindu denu aet. tvd ohumy srv jnyaanii srv bldhaarii.
eheyin ob allaah vet siyll bhaar krnu. niyt vshyenm ob paehaedili sty mt sittinnehiy.
niyt vshyenm numbtt (sty prtiksseep krn) mllvuntt svn vaekenntt saelaesviy nohaek. tvd (stytt kn noden) bihirn ovun psupslaa haerii yn vitt em aeryumtt svn vaekenntt saelaesviy nohaek.
andhyin nomg yaaemen ovuntt mg penvnnku les ob naet. apgee vdn vishvaas kr, avnt vn muslimvrun bvtt ptvuuvntt haer an aytt numbtt svn vaekenntt saellaesviy nohaek.
ovun vet (dnndduvmee) prkaashy ptit vuu vitt 'niyt vshyenm minisun apgee vdn tryee vishvaas nokrmin sittiyh' yaeyi ovun smg ktaa krn sttvyeku ovun venuven mhpolloven api baehaer krnnemu.
saaem smuuhykinm apgee vdn boru krmin sitti aygen pirisk api ekraes krn diny gaen menehi krnu. evitt ovuhu pell gsvaa tbnu lbti.
ovuhu paeminni vitt, maagee vdn pillibnd daenumk numblaatt notibiy dii numblaa ey boru kllehu d, esee naethot numblaa sidu krmin sittiyee kumkdae?yi ohu vimsyi.
ovun apraadh kll baevin ovun kerehi (dnndduvmee) prkaashy ptit viy. eheyin ovuhu ktaa nokrti.
ovun ehi vaasy krnu pinnis raatriyt dhvl penennk bvttt niyt vshyenm api aeti kll bv ovuhu noduttuvehu d? niyt vshyenm ehi vishvaas krn jnyaatt sNjnyaa aet.
hornnaaevehi pimbinu lbn din allaah abhimt kll ay haer ahshi sittin ay haa mhopollovee sittin ay taeti gniti. tvd siylu denaa ohu vet pht vuuvn lesin paeminnenu aet.

ob ey ghnv pihittaa aetaeyi sitn kndu dkinnehiy. (edin) eevaa vlaakullu gmn gnnaak men gmn krnu aet. ey saaem deykttm sthaavrtvyk aeti kll allaahgee nimaeyumki. niyt vshyenm ohu numblaa sidu krn daae pillibnd v abhijnyaanvnty.
kvreku yhpt raegen ennee d evitt iitt vddaa shreesstthtvyk ohu stu vnu aet. tvd ovuhu edin taetigaeniimen surkssityooy.
tvd kvreku npur raegen ennee d ovungee muhunnu niraa ginnehi munninttt hellnu laebee. numblaa sidu krmin sitti daae haer venekk numblaatt pirinmnu lbnnehu d?
niyt vshyenm mm ann krnu laebuvee mem ngry paarishuddh kll ehi prmaadhiptitt naemaedum kiriimtty. tvd siylu daae ohu stuy. tvd mm (allaahtt avnt vn) muslimvrun gen keneku viimtt d ann krnu laebuvemi.

tvd maa al kuraany paaraayny kiriimtt d ann krnu laebuvemi. eheyin kvreku yh mg lbnnee d esee ohu yh mg lbnuyee ohu venuveni. tvd kvreku nomg giyee d evitt niyt vshyenm mm avvaad krnnn aturin keneku vemi yaeyi numb (ohutt) pvsnu.

siylu prshNsaa allaahtty. ohugee sNjnyaa ohu numblaatt mtu penvnu aet. evitt numblaa ey daen gnnehuy. tvd numblaa sidu krn daae pillibnd numbgee prmaadhipti anvdhaaniyku novee yaeyi (nbivry) ob pvsnu.
taa, siin, miim
ey paehaedili deev grnthyee vdn vee.
vishvaas krn jnyaatt muusaagee haa firavungee puvt saebaae lesin api ob vet kiyvaa penvmu.

niyt vshyenm firavun mhpollovee abibvaa giyeey. tvd ohu ehi vaesiyn knnddaaym vltt bedaa ovun aturin pirisk durvl kott ovungee pirimi druvn mraa dmaa ovungee gaehaenu druvn jiivt krviiy. niyt vshyenm ohu klhkaariin aturin keneku viy.
mhpollovee durvlyin bvtt pt krnu laebuuvn htt upkaar kiriimttt ovun naaykyin bvtt pt kiriimttt ovun urumkkruvn bvtt pt kiriimttt api adhs kllemu.

tvd ovuntt api mhpollovee phsukm slsaa diimttt firavun haa haamaantt d,ovun dedenaagee seenaavntt d, ovun aturin kvr deyk pillibnd ovun prveeshmen kttyutu kllee d ey ovuntt ap penviimttt api adhs kllemu.

ohutt kiri den men d, ob ohu kerehi biy vuu vitt ohuv gnngtt dmn men d, tvd ob biy novnu tvd ob duk novnu yaeyi d, niyt vshyenm api ob vet ohu naevt lbaa dennn vemu emenm api ohu dhrm duutyin aturin keneku bvtt pt krnnoo vemu yaeyi d api muusaagee mvtt deev pnnividd dnvaa sittiyemu.

(muusaagee mv ohuv gnngtt daemuvaay. inpsu) firavungee nivaesiyn ohuv argth. ey ohu ovuntt stureku haa duktt heetuvk bvtt pt vnu pinnisy. niyt vshyenm firavun d haamaan d ovun dedenaagee seenaavn d vaerdi krnnoo vuuh.

mtt haa obtt nettt sisilki. numblaa ohu mraa nodmnu. ohu aptt pryoojnvt viy haek. esee naethot ohu druvku see (hdaavddaa) gt haekaeyi firavungee biriy paevsuvaay. tvd (saebaae ythaarthy) ovuntt novaetthunni.
muusaagee mvgee hdvt his viy. aey deviyn kerehi vishvaas krnniyn aturin kenku vnu pinnis aeygee hdvt api shktimt nokllemu nm aey ohu gaen helli krnntt tibunni.
ohu psupsin ynu yaeyi aey ohugee shoodriytt paevsuvaay. evitt ovun nodaenuvt v sittiy dii (ovun) aslinm sitt ohu des aey viprm kllaay.
api (mvtt bhaardiimtt) per kiri den mvvrun ohu vet thnm kllemu. evitt ohu bhaargnnaa nivaesiyn pillibnd v mm numblaatt dnvnnem d? ovuhu ohutt updes dennoo veti yaeyi aey (shoodriy) paevsuvaay.

api ohuv (muusaav) ohugee mv vetm naevt bhaar dunimu. (ebaevin) aeygee aes pinaa yaamttd aey duk noviimttd niyt vshyenm allaahgee prtijnyaav saebaaevki yaeyi aey daen gaeniimtt d saelaessuvemu. nmut ovungen bhutryk denaa nodniti.
ohu ohugee vaeddiviytt llnngaa vii printbhaavytt pt vuu klhi api ohutt prjnyaav haa jnyaany pirinaemuvemu. tvd elesy api daehaemiyntt prtiphl pirinmnuyee.

ehi vaesiyn nosaelkillen sitti mohotk ohu ngrytt pivisiiy. tm paarshvyen vuu keneku haa ohugee sturngen keneku gh mraa gth. evitt tm paarshvyee pudglyaa tm sturngen keneku vuu aytt erehi v ohugen udv paetiiy. evitt ohu(muusaa) ohutt phrk gaesiiy. evitt ohu vet (mrnny) tiindu viy. 'mey sseyitaangee kriyaavki. niyt vshyenm ohu nomg yvn paehaedili sturki' yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.

maagee prmaadhiptiyaanneni, niyt vshyenm mm mttm apraadh kr gttemi. eheyin mtt smaav denu maenv! yaeyi ohu praarthnaa klleey. evitt ohu ohutt smaav dunneey. niyt vshyenm mhaa krunnaanvit lesd atikssmaashiilii lesd sittinnee ohumy.
maagee prmaadhiptiyaanneni, ob mtt aashirvaad kll daae heetuven mm kisivittek vaerdikrnnn htt ur denneku novemi yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.

evitt ohu biytt pt v ngry tull niriikssaaven gmn krnneku bvtt pt viy. per din ohugen udv paetuu aym naevtt ohugen udv paetiiy. evitt niyt vshyenm ob paehaedili apraadhkaaryki yaeyi muusaa ohutt paevsiiy.

ovun dedenaattm sturu vuu ay allaa gnntt ohu situu klhi ahoo! muusaa, per din ob keneku mraa daemuvaak men ob maa mraa dmnntt sitnnehi d? ob mhpollovee daeddi paalkyku viimtt mis (venkk) adhs krnnee naet. emenm prtisNskrnn krnnn atr sittiimtt ob nositnnehiy yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.

ngryee aaet kellvr sitt miniseku div aevit ahoo! muusaa niyt vshyenm prdhaaniihu ob mraa daemiimtt ob gaen saakcchaa krti. eheyin ob baehaer v ynu. niyt vshyenm mm obtt updes dennn aturin keneku viimi yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.
evitt ohu biytt pt v niriikssaakaarii v in baehaer vii 'maagee prmaadhiptiyaanneni, apraadhkaarii jnyaagen maa mudvaa gnu' yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.
tvd ohu mdyn destt muhunnlaa giy klhi, maagee prmaadhipti mtt nivaerdi mg penvnntt pulluvnnaeyi ohu paevsiiy.

mdynhi jlaashy asltt ohu paeminni klhi jnyaa aturin (tm govipll stuntt) jly spyn prjaavk duttuveey. tvd ovun haer (in) vaellkii sittin ktun dedenku d ohu duttuveey. ob dedenaa ahktt vii sittinnee aeyi daeyi ohu vimsiiy. mem ennddeerun pitt v yn tek aptt jly saepyiy nohaek. tvd apgee piyaannn itaa vyoovRddh keneki yaeyi ovun dedenaa paevsuuh.
evitt ovun dedenaahtt ohu(muusaa) jly spyaa psu v hevnn vet haerii gos 'maagee prmaadhiptiyaanneni, ob maa vet phll kll yhpt kerehi mm avshytaa aetteku vemi' yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.

ovun dedenaagen ekiyk laejjaaven yutu v gmn krmin paeminn niyt vshyenm ap vet ob jly saepyuu daae sndhaa kuliy obtt pirinmnu pinnis maagee piyaannn obtt aaraadhnaa kllee yaeyi paevsuvaay. evitt ohu(muusaa) ohu(ayyuub) vet paeminni klhi (tmaagee) ktaav ohu vet paevsiiy. ob biy novnu. apraadhkaar jnyaagen ob midunnehiy yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.
maagee piyaannni, ob mohu kulii kruvku bvtt pt kr gnu. ob kulii kruvku bvtt pt kr gnnngen shreesstth vnuyee vishvaasniiy blvt ayki yaeyi ovun dedenaagen ekiyk paevsuvaay.

vsr attk mtt ob kulii seevyee nirt viimee pdnm ytttee mee maagee duuvrun dedenaagen ekiyk obtt vivaah kr diimtt niyt vshyenm mm adhs krmi. esee ob vsr dhyk smpuurnn kllehi nm ey (viy yuttee) obee kaemaett anuvy. mm ob dusskrtaavtt pt kiriimtt priy nokrmi. allaah abhimt kllee nm daehaemiyn aturin keneku lesin ob maa dkinu aetaeyi ohu(piyaa) paevsiiy.
ey maa atr haa ob atr vuuvki. kaalyn dekin kvr(kaaly)k maa ittu kll d evitt maa vet kisidu sturukmk naet. tvd allaah ap pvsn daae vet bhaarkruy yaeyi ohu(ayyuub) paevsiiy.

muusaa kaalvkvaanuv avsn kott tm pvul smg gmn gt klhi tuur kndu asl durkin ginnk duttuveey. 'numblaa mehi raendii sittinu. niyt vshyenm mm ginnk duttimi. in ym torturk hoo numblaa unnusum lbnu pinnis gini penellk hoo numblaa vet gen enntt mtt haeki vnu aet yaeyi paevsiiy.
evitt ee vet ohu paeminni klhi aashirvaad krnu laebuu bhuumi bhaagyee dkunnu mittiyaavt addr vuu gsin 'ahoo! muusaa, srv lookynhi prmaadhipti vuu allaah mm vemi yaeyi amtnu laebiiy.

tvd ob obee saeryttiy hellnu. ey srpyku men dnnglnu ohu duttu klhi psups haerii giyeey. tvd ohu (naevt) haerii nobaeluveey. ahoo! muusaa, ob idiriytt enu. tvd ob biy novnu. niyt vshyenm ob aarkssaa krnu laebuuvn aturini. (yaeyi pvsnu laebiiy.)

obee at obee saakkuv tulltt dmnu. ey kisidu haaniykin tor v suduvn lesin (baebllemin) hellivnu aet. biy daenunnu vitt obee aellpt ob vettt llN kr gnu. ee dek firavun haa ohugee prdhaaniin vet obee prmaadhipti vetin vuu saadhk dekki. niyt vshyenm ovuhu paaptr pirisk vuuh.
maagee prmaadhiptiyaanneni, ovun aturin keneku v mm mraa daemuvemi. eheyin ovun maa mraa dmnu aetaeyi mm biy vemi yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.
tvd maagee shoodr haaruun vn ohu mtt vddaa ktaaven ctury. eheyin maa thvuru krn udvkruvku vshyen ob ohu maa smg evnu. ovun maa boru krnu aetaeyi niyt vshyenm mm biy vemi (yaeyi muusaa paevsiiy.)

(eytt allaah) obee ur obee shoodryaa mgin api shktimt krnnemu. tvd ob dedenaatt blyk aeti krnnemu. eheyin ovuhu ob dedenaa vet smiip novnu aet. apgee sNjnyaa mgin ob dedenaa haa ob dedenaa anugmny kllvun (jy lbaa) abibvaa ynnoo veti.
muusaa apgee paehaedili sNjnyaa smg ovun vet paeminni klhi 'mey nirmaanny krnu laebuu huuniymk mis naetaeyi d apgee mul mutunmittn tull api mee gaen asaa naettemu' yaeyi d ovuhu paevsuuh.
tmn vetin yhmg raegen aavee kvurun daeyi d avsn nivhn kvurun stu vnnee daeyi d maagee prmaadhipti maenvin dnnaay. niyt vshyenm apraadhkruvn jy nolbnu aetaeyi muusaa paevsiiy.

tvd firavn (mesee) paevaesuveey, ahoo! prdhaaniyni, maa haer vent devindeku numblaatt aetaeyi mm nodnimi. eheyin ahoo! haamaan, muusaagee deviyaa vet ebii baeliy haekivnu pinnis maa venuven us maendurk tnnu. tvd niyt vshyenm ohu musaavaadiin aturin yaeyi mm sitmi.
ohu haa ohugee seenaavn yuktiyen tor v mhpollovehi ahNkaarkm paaevooy. niyt vshyenm tmn ap vet naevt haerii enu nolbn bv ovuhu situuh.
eheyin ohu haa ohugee seenaav api hsu kllemu. api ovun muhudtt helluvemu. eheyin apraadhkruvngee avsaany kesee vii daeyi avdhaanyen blnu.
tvd api ovun niry vet aeryum krn naaykyin bvtt pt kllemu. tvd mllvun keren naegittuvnu lbn dinyee ovun udv krnu nolbti.
melovehi shaapyk api ovun psups evnnemu. mllvun keren naegittuvnu lbn dinyee ovuhu durs krnu lbnnn aturin veti.
tvd mul prmpraavn ap vinaash kiriimen psu v minisaa updes laebiy haeki vnu pinnis ohutt saadhk vshyen d mgpenviimk haa dyaavk vshyen d saebaevinm api muusaatt dhm grnthy pirinaemuvemu.
muusaatt niiyoogy ap tiindu kll avsthaavee ob btthir asl nosittiyehiy. tvd ob saakssikruvn aturin d noviiy.

tvd ob piduru mittiyk obee attt gen emgin ob (obee biriytt) gsnu. tvd ob prtijnyaa kdd nokrnu. niyt vshyenm api ohu ivsilivntyku see duttuvemu. em gaettaa itaa yhpt viy. niyt vshyenm ohu (allaah vet) imht les haerenneki.

tvd niyt vshyenm ovun ap abiys vishissttyin les tooraa gnu laebuuvn aturini.

api ovun smcclytt gttemu d? esee naethot ovungen (apgee) baelm ivt vuuyee d?
niyt vshyenm ey saebaaevki. ey niraavaasiingee vaadyyi.

psu v mm ohu nisi ayurin haeddgsvaa maagee aatmyen ohu tull pimbuu vitt numblaa ohutt sujuud (aacaar) krnnn les vaettenu. (yaeyi allaah paevaesuveey)
evitt mlkvrun vn ovun siylloom sujuud kllooy.

"ahoo ibliis! maagee daaetin maa maevuu daaett ob sujuud kiriimen ob v vaellaekvuuyee kumk d? ob uddnngu vuuyehi d esee naethot uss ay aturin vuuyehi dae"yi ohu(allaah) vimsiiy.
"mm ohutt vddaa shreesstty. ob maa mvaa aettee ginneni. tvd ob ohu mvaa aettee maettiyeni" yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.
"esee nm ob meyin baehaer vnu. niyt vshyenm ob plvaa hrinu laebuuveki.
tvd niyt vshyenm vinishcy diny dkvaa maagee shaapy obtt erehi v pvtii" yaeyi ohu (allaah) paevsiiy.
"maagee prmaadhiptiyaanneni! esee nm ovun naevt naegittuvnu lbn diny dkvaa mtt kl denu" yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.

niymit veelaavee diny dkvaa.

(mey) srv bldhaarii mhaa prjnyaavnt allaahgen vuu grnthyee phll kiriimki.
niyt vshyenm api ob vet deev grnthy styyen yutu v phll kllemu. eheyin ob avNk lesin allaahtt pmnnk dhm pud kott ohutt naemdum krnu.

daen gnu! pivituru dhm allaah stuy. tvd ohu haer vent ay aarksskyin les gt ay 'allaah vet ap smiip krviimtt mis api ovuntt naemdum nokllemu (yaeyi pvsti). ovun kvr deyk tull mtbheed aeti krgtteed ee pillibnd v allaah ovun atr niyt vshyenm tiindu denu aet. niyt vshyenm allaah borukaar prtiksseep krnnnhtt mg nopenvyi.

ekm aatmykin ohu numblaa maevveey. psu v eyin ehi shkaariy aeti klleey. govipll stungen jooddu attk numblaatt phll klleey. tun aakaar andhkaaryn tull maeviimkin psu maeviimk lesin numblaagee mvvrungee kusvl tull ohu numblaa maevveey. eyyi numblaagee prmaadhipti vuu allaah. siylu aadhiptyyn ohu stuy. ohu haer vent deviyeku naet. esee nm numblaa venetktt yomu krnu lbnuyee keseed?

numblaa (gunnmku les) prtiksseep krnnee nm evitt (daen gnu,) niyt vshyenm allaah numblaa gaen avshytaavngen tory. tm gaettn sndhaa (gunnmku les) prtiksseep kiriim ohu priy nokryi. tvd numblaa kRtveedii vnnee nm ee gaen ohu numblaa kerehi tRptiytt pt veyi. br usulnneku vent aygee (pv) br nousulnu aet. psu v numblaa naevt yomu viy yutu sthaany aettee numblaagee prmaadhipti vety. evitt numblaa krmin sitti daae pillibnd v ohu numblaatt dnvyi. niyt vshyenm ohu hdvt stu daae pillibnd v maenvin dnnaay.

tvd minisaatt ym haaniyk sprsh vuu vitt ohu tm prmaadhipti vet yomu vii ohutt knnlv kryi. psu v ohutt ohugen vuu ym anugrhyk pirinaemuu vitt ohu miitt per kvr deyk vet knnlv krmin sittiyee d ey amtk kott allaahgee maargyen nomg yvnu pinnis ohutt smaanyn tbyi. "ob obee deev prtiksseepy smg svlp kaalyk bhukti vidinu. niyt vshyenm ob (niraa)ginnee sgyin aturini" yaeyi (nbi muhmmd,) ob pvsnu.

mtu lov pillibnd biyen haa tm prmaadhiptigee aashirvaady apeekssaaven raatrii hooraavnhi (slaatyeedii) sujuud krnnku see d naegii sittinneku see d gaetikm kiriimtt avdi v sittinnaa (esee nokrnneku men)d? "niyt vshyenm maa allaahtt avNk lesin ohutt pmnnk dhm pud kr naemdiimtt maa ann krnu laebuvemi" yaeyi (nbi muhmmd) ob pvsnu.

eheyin numblaa ohu haer numblaa abhimt daaett gaetikm krnu. (nbivry,) "niyt vshyenm praajityin vnuyee mllvun keren naegittuvnu lbn dinyee tmntt haa tm pvultt paaddu aeti kr gttvuny. daen gnu. eyyi prktt praajy" yaeyi pvsnu.

ovuntt ihllin (niraa) ginnen vuu aavrnnyk d ovuntt phllin aavrnnyk d ovuntt aet. ey allaah emgin tm gaettn biy aeti kryi."ahoo maagee gaettni! eheyin numblaa mtt biy baetimt vnu." (yaeyi tvdurttt pvsnu.)
npuru blveegyngen (ivt v) eevaatt naemdum kiriimen vaellkii allaah vet naemburu vuuvn vnaahi ovuntty shubhaashiNsny aettee. eheyin maagee gaettn htt ob subaarNci dnvnu.
prkaashytt svn dii ey vddaat alNkaar ayurin anugmny krnnn vnaahi allaah ovuntt mg penvuu ay ovuhumy. tvd ovuhumy prbuddhimt udviy vnnoo.
(nbivry!) kvurun kerehi dnndduvm pillibnd vdn sthiir vuveed, ginnehi sittin ohuv obtt aarkssaa krnnehid?

niyt vshyenm allaah ahsin jly phll kott ey mhpollovee ulpt atr glaa ynntt slsvaa emgin (vividh vrnnvlin yut) vividh vrgyee boog htt gnvaa paehenntt slsvyi. evitt ob ey rnvn paehaeyen dkinu aet. psu v ey ipaenaeli bvtt pt kryi. niyt vshyenm ehi buddhimtuntt updesk aet.

allaah kvrekugee hdvt islaamy vet vivRt klleed saebaevinm ohu ohugee prmaadhiptigee aalooky mt sittinneey. allaah v menehi kiriimen durs vuu baevin tm hdvt rlluvuuvntt vinaashy atveevaa! ovuhu paehaedili nomgehi veti.

tm prmaadhiptitt biyvnnngee hm emgin killipollaa yn, naevt naevtt (yugl vshyen) prkaash vn ekinektt smaan alNkaar ktaav grnthyk vshyen ohu phll klleey. psu v ovungee hm haa ovungee hdvt allaah menehi kiriim sndhaa mollok vnu aet. ey allaahgee mg penviimyi. ohu abhimt krn aytt emgin ohu mg penvnu aet. tvd allaah kvreku nomg ynntt idd haeriyeed ohutt kisidu mg penvnnku naet.
mllvun keren naegittuvnu lbn dinyee npuru dnndduvmin tm muhunn aarkssaa kr gnnaa kvud?"numblaa upymin sitti daae numblaa bhukti vindinu" yaeyi apraadhkruvntt kiynu laebee.
ovuntt (mkkaavee visuu prtiksseep kllvuntt) per sittiyvun (deev vdn) boru kllooy. eheyin ovun nodaen sittiydii ovun vet dnndduvm paeminniyeey.
evitt melov jiivityee avmaany allaah ovuntt vindinntt saelaesviiy. tvd mtu lov dnndduvm atimhty. ovuhu daen sittiyaahu nm!

mtbheedvlin yut (bohoo) hvulkruvn stu vuu minisek haa ekm minisekutt pmnnk ayt vuu minisek allaah upmaa vshyen gen haer daekviiy. upmaaven ovun dedenaa ek haa smaan d? siylu prshNsaa allaahtty. nmut ovungen bhutryk denaa nodniti.

aatmaavn eevaa mrnnytt pt vn mohotee d nindeedii mrnnytt pt novuu daae d atpt kr gnnee allaahy. kvr aatmyk mt mrnny tiindu klleed ey (aapsu noyvaa) ohu rndvaa tbaa gnii. sesu daae niym krn ld kaalyk dkvaa ohu evnu aet. vtthaa gnnaa jnyaatt niyt vshyenm ehi sNjnyaa aet.
esee naethot ovuhu allaahgen tor v maedihtkruvn gttoo d? "ovun kisivktt himikm nodrmin buddhimt novnnn les sittiy d (ovun maedihtkruvn les gnnehu d)" yaeyi (nbivry) ob pvsnu.
"siylu maedihtviim allaah stuy. ahs haa mhpollovee aadhiptyy ohu stuy. psu v numblaa naevt yomu krnu lbnuyee ohu vety". yaeyi (nbi muhmmd) ob pvsnu.
allaah pmnnk menehi krnu laebuu vitt mtu lov vishvaas nokrnnngee hdvt haekilii yyi. ohugen torvuuvn menehi krnu lbn vitt evitt ovuhu stuttu veti.

ovun upyaa gt daaehi npurukm ovuntt hellivnu aet. tvd ovun kvr deyk pillibnd v srdm krmin sittiyee d ey ovun vttlaa gnu aet.

minisaatt ym haaniyk sprsh vuu vitt ohu aptt knnlv kryi. psu v apgen vuu dyaavk api ohutt pirinaemuu vitt, "niyt vshyenm ey mtt denu laebuvee (maagee) daenum anuvy" yaeyi pvsyi. naet ey priikssnnyki. nmut ovungen bhutryk denaa (ee bv) nodniti.

eheyin ovun ipaeyuu daaehi npuru vipaaky ovunv alvaagtteey. ovun aturin apraadh kllvun ovun ipaeyuu daaehi npuru vipaak ovunv mtu alvaagnneey. tvd ovuhu (styy) praajytt pt krnnn noveti.
niyt vshyenm allaah tmn abhimt krn aytt poossnn smpt vyaapt kr den bvt emenm ohu ey siimaa kr den bvt ovuhu nodnnoo d? niyt vshyenm vishvaas krn jnyaatt ehi saadhk aet.

ahoo tmn visin tmnv nsaa gt maagee gaettni! allaahgee krunnaav gaen numblaa apeekssaa rhit novnu. niyt vshyenm allaah siylu paapyntt smaav denu aet. niyt vshyenm ohu atikssmaashiiliiy. mhaa krunnaanvity.
tvd dnndduvm numblaa vet paeminniimtt per numblaa numblaagee prmaadhipti vet naemburu vnu. tvd ohutt yttht vnu. psu v numblaa udv krnu nolbnnehuy.

allaah smbndhyen maa vaerdi kr tibiim heetuven mtt vinaashyyi. tvd niyt vshyenm mm smccl krnnn aturin vuuyemi yaeyi keneku pvsaa sittiimtt per (numblaa vet phll krnu laebuu vddaat alNkaar daae pillipdinu.)
esee naethot niyt vshyenm allaah mtt mg penvuuyee nm mm biy baetimtun aturin vnntt tibunni yaeyi keneku pvsaa sittiimtt per d,
esee naethot dnndduvm dkin vitt "mtt tvt vaaryk vii nm mm daehaemiyn aturin vemi" yaeyi keneku pvsaa sittiimtt per ( numblaa vet phll krnu laebuu vddaat alNkaar daae pillipdinu.)
"esee nov, saebaevinm maagee vdn ob vet paeminniyeey. evitt ob eevaa boru kllehiy. tvd ob uddnngu vuuyehiy. tvd ob prtiksseep krnnn aturin vuuyehiy."
tvd allaah kerehi boru paevsuuvn, mllvun keren naegittuvnu lbn dinyee ovungee muhunnu kllu paehae gaenvii tibiim ob dkinu aet. uddnngu vuuvntt niryee nvaataenk noveed?
tvd biy baetimt vuuvn ovungee jygrhnnyn heetuven allaah ovun mudvaa gnu aet. ovuntt npur htt nognii. emenm ovuhu duktt pt noveti.

"ob aadeesh kllehi nm obgee kriyaa saebaevinm nissphl vii ynu aet. tvd ob praajityin aturin vnu aetae"yi ob vet haa obtt per visuuvn vet deev pnnividd evnu laebiiy.

tvd allaah v niym ayurin mhimytt pt kll yutu aakaarytt ovuhu ohv mhimytt pt nokllh. tvd mllvun keren naegittuvnu lbn dinyee mhpollov mullumnninm ohugee grhnnyee pvtii. tvd ahs ohugee dkunntehi otnu laeb tibee. ovun aadeesh krn daeyin ohu uttriitry. suvishuddhy.

saaem aatmykm eevaa sidu kll daaett puurnn v (prtiphl) denu laebee. tvd ovun sidu krn daae pillibnd v ohu maenvin dnnaay.

deviyn prtiksseep kllvun niry vet knnddaaym vshyen meheyvaa gen ynu laebee. ovuhu ee dkvaa paeminni vitt ehi dorttu vivRt krnu laebee. numblaagee prmaadhiptigee vdn paaraayny krn dhm duutvrun numblaa aturin numblaa vet nopaeminniyee d? tvd numblaagee mem dinyee hmuv pillibnd numblaatt avvaad nokllee dae?yi ehi bhaarkruvn ovungen vimsnu aet. eseey. yaeyi ovuhu pvsti. enmut deviyn prtiksseep kllvun vet dnndduvmee prkaashy niym viy.
numblaa ehi sdaatnikyin lesin niryee dorttu vlin aetullu vnu. uddnnguvuuvngee nvaataen npuru viy.

tm prmaadhiptitt biy baetimt vuuvn svrgy vet knnddaaym vshyen meheyvaa gen ynu laebee. ovuhu ee dkvaa paeminni vitt ehi dorttu vivRt krnu laebee. "numblaatt slaam (shaantiyyi.) numblaa yhpt ayurin kttuyutu kr aet. eheyin sdaatnikyin lesin ehi numblaa pivisenu." yaeyi ehi bhaarkruvn ovuntt pvsnu aet.
"tm poronduv aptt saebaae kll, tvd mhpollo v aptt urumkr dun allaahttm siylu prshNsaa. api kaemti pridi svrgyee vaasy krnnemu" yaeyi ovuhu pvsnu aet. eheyin kriyaakaariingee prtiphl yhpt viy.

tvd arss avtt pirivraagen tm prmaadhiptigee prshNsaav tullin ohu v pivituru krmin sittin mlkvrun ob dkinu aet. ovun atr styyen yutu v tiindu denu laebee. skl lookynhi prmaadhipti vuu allaahttm siylu prshNsaa yaeyi pvsnu laebee.
haa miim
deev grnthyee phll kiriim srv bldhaarii, srvjnyaanii, allaahgeni.
(ohu) paapytt smaav dennaay. paapkssmaav pillignnaay. daeddi les dnndduvm krnnaay. tyaagshiiliiy. ohu haer vent devindeku naet. naevt yomu viim ohu vetmy.
deviyn prtiksseep kllvun haer (vent kisivku) allaahgee vdn smbndhyen trk nokrnu aet. eheyin ngrvlvl ovungee saerisaeriim ob v noraevttiy yutuy.

ovuntt per vuu nuuhgee jnyaa d ovuntt psu vuu sturu knnddaaym d (ovungee dhm duutvrun) boru kllooy. saaem smuuhykm tmngee dhm duutyaannnv grhnny kiriimtt taet kllooy. tvd ovun styy vinaash krnu pinnis astyy gen emgin trk kllooy. eheyin mm ovun grhnny kllemi. evitt maagee dnndduvm kesee viid?
elesm niyt vshyenm ovuhu (niraa) ginnee sgyoo vetaeyi deviyn prtiksseep kllvun kerehi obee prmaadhiptigee prkaashy niym viy.

arssy usulaa gen sittinnn haa ee avtt sittinnn ovungee prmaadhiptigee prshNsaav tullin suvishuddh krti. tvd ohuv vishvaas krti. tvd apgee prmaadhiptiyaanneni! dyaaven haa daenumen siylu daae ob pullul les aavrnny kr sittinnehiy. eheyin psutaevili vii obgee maargy anugmny kllvunhtt ob smaav denu maenv! tvd niryee veednaaven ob ovun aarkssaa krnu maenv! yaeyi vishvaas kllvuntt smaav ayaed sittiti.

apgee prmaadhiptiyaanneni! ob ovuntt prtijnyaa dun sdaatnik svrg uyn tulltt ovun haa ovungee mutun mittn ovungee biriyn haa ovungee prpurin daehaemi daae kllvun d aetullt krnu maenv! niyt vshyenm ob srv bldhaariiy. mhaa prjnyaavnty.
tvd ob ovun npuru vlin aarkssaa krnu. tvd ob kvreku edin npuru vlin aarkssaa krnnee d saebaevin ob ohutt krunnaav daekvuuyehiy. tvd eyyi atimht jygrhnny.

'deev vishvaasy vet numblaa aeryum krnu lbn vitt numblaa prtiksseep krmin sitti avsthaavee numblaa tull vuu pillikultt vddaa allaahgee pillikul imhty.' yaeyi niyt vshyenm prtiksseep kllvun vn ovuntt aeryum krnu laebiiy.

apgee prmaadhiptiyaanneni, ob ap devtaavk mrnnytt pt kllehiy. tvd ob aptt devtaavk jiivy dunnehiy. eheyin apgee paapyn api pillignnemu. eheyin baehaer viimtt kisiym mgk aet dae?yi ovuhu (prtiksseep krnnn) vimsaa sittiti.
ey (vuu klii), allaah pmnnk aeryum krnu lbn vitt numblaa prtiksseep kllehuy. ohutt aadeesh krnu lbnnee nm numblaa vishvaas kllehuy. eheyin tiinduv atimht vuu uttriitr allaah stuy.
ohu vnaahi ohu ohugee sNjnyaavn numblaatt penvyi. tvd numblaatt ahsin poossnn smpt phll kryi. (ohu vet) yomuvnnn haer (vent kisivku) updes nolbnnooy.
eheyin deev prtiksseepkyoo pillikul kll d numblaa allaahtt pmnnk dhm pud krmin avNkyin les ohutt knnlv krnu.

(ohu ohugee) traatirmhi utkRsstty. arss (hevt siNhaasnye)hi himipaannny. ekinekaa hmuvn diny pillibnd avvaad krnu pinnis ohu tm gaettn aturin abhimt krnnn vet tm niyoogyen vuu deev pnnividd phll kryi.
edin ovuhu ellimhnee idiriytt paeminaennn veti. ovungen kisivk allaah vetin nosaenngveyi. edin aadhiptyy kvurun stu d? yttht kott paalny krnnaa vuu eekiiy vuu allaahtt pmnny.
ad din saaem aatmykm ovun upyaa gt daae venuven prtiphl denu lbti. ad din kisidu apraadhyk naet. niyt vshyenm allaah vinishcy kiriimehi veegvty.

tvd ob shiighryen paeminnen diny gaen ovuntt avvaad krnu. evitt hdvt ugurutt llnngaa vii (gil gt nohaekiv) hir vii pvtii. kisidu udvkruvku hoo pillignu lbn kisidu maedihtkruvku hoo apraadhkruvnhtt nomaet.
aes vl pvtin vNcaav haa hdvt snngvaa aeti daaed ohu (allaah) dnii.
tvd allaah yuktishgtv tiindu deyi. ohu haer ovun aeryum krn ay kisivk smbndhyen hoo tiindu nodeti. niyt vshyenm allaah vn ohumy srv shraavk srv niriikssk vnuyee.

tvd ovuhu mhpollovee saerisraa ovuntt per sittiyvungee avsaany kesee viidaeyi ovuhu adhiikssnnyen nobaeluvoo d? ovuhu movuntt vddaa mhpollovee blyen haa slkunnu taebiimen adhik vuuh. evitt ovungee paapkm heetuven allaah ovun grhnny klleey. tvd allaahgen (ovun) mudvaagnneku ovuntt noviiy.
ey ovun vet ovungee dhm duutvrun paehaedili saadhk smg paeminniy d ovuhu prtiksseep kll baevini. eheyin allaah ovun grhnny klleey. niyt vshyenm ohu blvty. dnndduvm diimehi daeddiy.
tvd saebaevinm api muusaa v apgee sNjnyaa haa paehaedili anublyk smg yaevvemu.
firavun haamaan haa kaaruun vet yaevvemu. evitt ovuhu (mohu) huuniymkruveki. mhaa borukaaryeki yaeyi ovuhu paevsuuh.

ap vetin vuu styy smg ohu ovun vet paeminni klhi "ohu smg vuu deviyn vishvaas kllvungee pirimi druvn mraa dmnu. ovungee gaehaenuntt jiivit daany denu." yaeyi ovuhu paevsuuh. deviyn prtiksseep krnnngee kumntrnny mullaavehi mis naet.

"numblaa maa athaer dmnu. mm muusaa v mraa dmmi. tvd ohu ohugee prmaadhiptitt aeryum krtvaa! numblaagee dhm ohu vens krnu aet, esee naethot mh pollovee ohu arbudh aeti krnu aetaeyi saebaevinm mm biy vemi" yaeyi firavun paevsiiy.
"vinishcy diny pillibnd vishvaas nokrn saaem ahNkaarykugenm, mm maagee prmaadhipti haa numblaagee prmaadhiptigen aarkssaav ptmi" yaeyi muusaa paevsuveey.

"maagee prmaadhipti allaah yaeyi paevsiim heetuven numblaa miniseku mraa dmnnehu d? numblaagee prmaadhipti vetin paehaedili saadhk smg saebaevinm ohu numblaa vet paeminn aet. tvd ohu borukaaryku vnnee nm ohugee boruv ohutt erehivmy. tvd ohu styvaadiyeku vnnee nm numblaatt prtijnyaa dun aetaem daae numblaatt htt gnu aet. kvreku siimaav ikmvaa ymin mhaa borukaaryku les sittiyee d saebaevinm allaah ohutt mg penvnnee naetae" yi firavungee pvul aturin tm vishvaasy snngvaa sitti miniseku paevsiiy.

ahoo jnyini! ad din numblaa mhpollovee abibvaa ymin aadhiptyy numblaa stu kr gen aet. nmut allaahgee dnndduvm ap vet paeminniyee nm in aptt upkaar krnuyee kvu d? (yaeyi ohu tvdurttt vimsiiy.) maa dkin daae haer venekk mm numblaatt nopenvmi. emenm yhmg haer vent mgk mm numblaatt nopenvmi" yaeyi firavun paevsiiy.
ahoo maagee jnyini! seenaaNkyngee din men numblaa vet siduviim gaen niyt vshyenm mm biy vemi yaeyi biybaeti vishvaasvnt ohu paevsuveey.

nuuhgee jnyaa, aad, smuud haa ovuntt per sitti knnddaaym vaeni aytt siduvuuvaak men (ymk numblaa vet siduviim gaen niyt vshyenm mm biy vemi) tvd gaettn htt apraadhyk sidu kiriimtt allaah apeekssaa nokryi." yaeyi vishvaas kll em pudglyaa paevsiiy.
"tvd, ahoo maagee jnyini! knnlv krn diny numblaavet paeminniim gaen mm biy vemi."
"numblaa pittupaamin plaa yn dinyee allaahgen aarkssaa krn kisiveku numblaatt naet. tvd allaah kvreku nomg hrinnee d evitt ohutt kisidu mg penvnneku naet."

"tvd miitt per saebaevinm yuusuf paehaedili saadhk smg numblaa vet paeminniyeey. nmut ohu kvr deyk numblaa vet gen aavee d ee gaen saekyehi numblaa ivt novii sittiyehuy. ohu miy giy vitt ohugen psu v 'allaah rsuulvryku evnneem naetaeyi' numblaa paevsuuvehuy. kvreku siimaav ikmvaa ymin saek aeti krnnee d evaennn allaah nomg yvnuyee elesy."

"ovuhu vnaahi ovuntt paeminni kisidu bl saadhkyk nomaetiv ovuhu allaahgee vdn smbndhyen trk krti. allaah abiys haa vishvaas kllvun abiys vairy atimht viy. ahNkaar blaadhikaarii saaem hdvtk mt m allaah mudraa tbnuyee elesy."
firavun mesee paevsiiy "ahoo haamaan! maa venuven us goddnaegillk idi krnu maenv! enm ahshi maarg vet maa pivisiimtt haeki venu pinnis.

tvd ahshi maarg vet maa pivis muusaagee deviyaa maa daekblaa gt yutuyi. "enmut niyt vshyenm ohu borukaaryeku les mm sitmi" firavungee npuru kriyaavn ohutt alNkaar kr penvnu laebuvee elesy. tvd Rju maargyen ohu vllkvnu laebiiy. firavungee kumntrnny vinaashy tull mis noviiy.
"ahoo maagee jnyini! maa anugmny krnu maenv, mm numblaatt Rju maargy vet mg penvmi" yaeyi vishvaas kll em taenaettaa paevsiiy.
"ahoo maagee jnyini! niyt vshyenm mee melov jiivity sullu bhukti vindiimk pmnni. tvd niyt vshyenm mtu lov sdaa nivhnyi."

"kvreku ym npurk sidu kllee d ee haa smaan deyk mis ohutt prtiphl vshyen denu nolaebee. tvd ym pirimiyku hoo veevaa kaantvk hoo veevaa tmn vishvaasvntyku v sitt daehaemi kriyaavk sidu kllee d svrgytt pivis, ehi kisidu gnnnykin tor v poossnny denu lbn ay vnuyee ovuhumy."
"ahoo maagee jnyini! mtt tiben avshytaav kumkd? mm numblaa jygrhnny vet aeryum krmi. nmut numblaa (niryee) ginn vet maa aeryum krnnehuy."

"maa allaah prtiksseep krnu pinnist kvr deyk pillibnd mtt daenumk nomaettee d evn deyk ohutt maa aadeesh krnu pinnist numblaa maahtt aeryum krnnehuy. tvd mm numblaa aeryum krnuyee ati kssmaashiilii srv bldhaariyaannn vety."

"niyt vshyenm numblaa kvr keneku vet maa aeryum krnnee d ohutt melov hoo mtu lov (aeryum kiriimee) kisidu urumyk naetaeyi ynnttt saebaevinm apgee naevt yomu viimee sthaany allaah vety ynnttt tvd niyt vshyenm siimaav ikmvaa giyvun vn ovuhu (niraa) ginnee sgyin vnneey ynnttt kisidu saekyk naet."
maa numblaa vet pvsn daae gaen numblaa mtu sihipt krnu aet. tvd maagee krunn mm allaah vet yomu krmi. niyt vshyenm allaah gaettn pillibnd v srv niriikssky.
ovun kumntrnn kll daaehi (siylu) npurukm vlin allaah ohu aarkssaa klleey. tvd dnndduvmee bihisunnukm firavungee seenaav vaettliiy.
(niryee) ginn, ee vet ovun udee svs idiript krnu lbti. avsn hooraav siduvn din "firavungee seenaav daeddi dnndduvm vet aetullt krnu." (yaeyi ann krnu laebee.)

tvd (niraa) ginnee ovun ekinekaa vaad krmin sittin vitt "niyt vshyenm api numblaa anugmny krmin sittiyemu. eheyin (niraa) ginnen kottsk apgen ivt krnnn les numblaa sittinnehu" daeyi dublyoo uddnngu vuu aygen vimsnu aet.
"niyt vshyenm api siylloom sittinnee ehiy. niyt vshyenm allaah gaettn atr tiindu dii aetae"yi uddnngu vuuvoo pvsti.
"dnndduvmin dink ap vetin ohu saehaellu kiriimtt numblaa numblaagee prmaadhiptitt knnlv krnu." yaeyi (niraa) ginnee sittinnoo niryee bhaarkruvntt pvsti.

"numblaagee dhm duutvrun paehaedili saadhk smg nopaeminniyee dae"yi ovuhu vimsti. "eseey" yaeyi ovuhu pvsti. "esee nm numblaa aeryum krnu" yaeyi ovuhu kiyti. tvd deev prtiksseepkyingee aeryum mullaavehi mis naet.
melov jiivityee haa saakssikruvoo naegii sittin (mtu lov) dinyehi saebaevinm api apgee dhm duutvruntt haa vishvaas kllvuntt udv krnnemu.

(ey) prbuddhimt aytt mg penviimk haa menehi kiriimk vshyeni.
eheyin (nbivry) ob ivsnu. niyt vshyenm allaahgee prtijnyaav saebaaevki. tvd obee paapy sndhaa ob smaav aydinu. tvd obee prmaadhiptigee prshNsaav tullin svs kaalyee haa udaaesn pivituru krnu.

niyt vshyenm tmn vet paeminni kisidu adhikaarii blyk notibiy dii allaahgee vdn smbndhyen trk krnnn vn ovungee sit tull uddnngukm mis venekk naet. ovuhu ey lbnnn noveti. eheyin ob allaahgen aarkssaav ayaed sittinu. niyt vshyenm ohu srv shraavky. srv jnyaaniiy.
minisaa maeviimtt vddaa ahs haa mhpollov maeviim ati mhty. nmut jnyaagen bhutryk denaa (ee bv) nodniti.
tvd andhyaa haa penumaettaa smaan noveti. tvd vishvaas kott yhkm sidu kllvun haa dussttkm krnnaa d (smaan) noveti. svlpyki numblaa menehi krnuyee.
niyt vshyenm avsn hooraav paeminnennkmy. ehi kisidu saekyk naet. nmut jnyaagen bhutryk denaa (ey) vishvaas nokrti.

"numblaa maa amtnu. mm numblaa(gee praarthnaav) pillignimi. niyt vshyenm mtt praarthnaa kiriimen (aaet vii) uddnngukm paamin sittiyvun avmaanytt pt vuuvn lesin nirytt mtu pivisenu aet." yaeyi numblaagee prmaadhipti pvsyi.
raatriy ehi numblaa saensum lbnu pinnist dhvl penenntt haeki lest numblaa venuven aeti kllee allaahy. niyt vshyenm allaah jnyaa vet bhaagyy pirinmnnaay. nmut jnyaagen bhutryk denaa kRtveedii noveti.
eyyi numblaagee prmaadhipti vuu allaah. (ohu) siylu daaehi maevumkruy. ohu haer vent deviyku naet. esee nm numblaa (mullaa krnu laeb) ventktt yomu krnu lbnuyee kesee d?
allaahgee vdn hellaa dkimin sitti ay ventktt hrvnu lbnuyee elesy.

mhpollov vaass sthaanyk les d ahs viynk les d numblaa venuven aeti kllee allaahy. tvd numblaagee haeddruv ohu alNkaar klleey. tvd numblaav ohu haedd gaenviiy. tvd yhpt daeyin numblaatt ohu poossnn smpt pirinaemiiy. eyyi numblaagee prmaadhipti vuu allaah. eheyin lookynhi prmaadhipti vuu allaah atiutkRsstt viy.
ohu jiivmaanyaay. ohu haer vent deviyku naet. eheyin numblaa ohutt pmnnk dhm pud kr avNkyin lesin ohu aeryum krnu. lookynhi prmaadhipti vuu allaahttm siylu prshNsaa.

maagee prmaadhiptigen paehaedili sNjnyaa maa vet paeminni klhi allaahgen tor v numblaa aeryum krn aytt maa naemdum kiriimen niyt vshyenm mm thnm krnu laebuvemi. tvd lookynhi prmaadhiptitt maa yttht vnnttt mm ann krnu laebuvemi. yaeyi (nbivry) ob pvsnu.

maettiyen d psu v shukraannu binduvkin d psu v ellii pvtin kaettiykin d numblaa maevvee ohuy. psu v ohu numblaa billideku vshyen baehaer kryi. psu v numblaa vaeddiviytt ptvnnttt psuv vyoovRddhbhaavytt ptvnnttt ohu slsvyi. numblaa aturin iitt per mrnnytt pt krnu lbnnn d veti. numblaa vtthaa gt haeki vnu pinnis (mesee) niymit kaalyk dkvaa numblaa llnngaa vnntt idd hriyi.
jiivy denneet mrnnytt pt krnneet ohuy. eheyin ohu ym krunnk siduviimtt tiindu kllee nm evitt 'siduvenu' yaeyi eytt pvsnvaa pmnni. evitt ey siduvenu aet.

ovun vnaahi, deev grnthy haa ap kvr deyk smg apgee dhm duutvru evvemu d ey d borukllvuny. ehet ovuhu mtu daen gnu aet.

"ovun apgen mullaa vii aet. nmudu miitt per api kisivk aeryum krmin nosittiyemu" yaeyi ovuhu pvsti. elesy prtiksseep krnnn allaah nomg ynntt hrinuyee

eheyin (nbivry) ob ivsiimen sittinu. niyt vshyenm allaahgee prtijnyaav saebaaevki. eheyin saebaevinm api obtt penvnuyee ap ovuntt prtijnyaa dun daae hi smhrk pmnni. esee naethot, api ob mrnnytt pt krnnemu. evitt ovun naevt yomu krnu lbnuyee ap vetmy.

evitt ovun vet ovungee dhm duutvrun paehaedili saadhk smg paeminni klhi, tmn llnng tiben daenum gaen ovuhu (ahNkaaryen yutu v) stuttu vuuh. ovun kvr deyk pillibnd smccl krmin sittiyee d ey ovun vttkr gtteey.

nmut ovun apgee dnndduvm duttu klhi ovungee vishvaasy ovuntt pryoojnvt noviiy. (ey) tm gaettn atrehi ikut v giy allaahgee pillivety. ehidii deviyn prtiksseep krnnoo praajit vuuh.

saaem mhaa borukaar paaptrykuttm vinaashy at veevaa!

ohu vet kiyvaa penvn ld allaahgee vdn vltt ohu svn deyi. psu v ohu eytt svn nodunnaak men uddnnguven hituvkkaar les haesireyi. eheyin veedniiy dnndduvm pillibnd v (nbitumni!) ob ohutt shubhaarNci denu.
ohu apgee vdn aturin kisivk hoo daen gt vitt ey ohu vihilluvtt gtteey. nindaa shgt dnndduvmk tmn stu kr gttoo ovuhumy.
ovuntt psupsin niry aet. ovuhu kvr deyk upyaa gttee d ey hoo allaahgen tor v ovuhu bhaarkruvn les gt daae hoo ovuntt phlk novnu aet. tvd ovuntt mht dnndduvmk aet.
mey yh maargyyi. tvd ovungee prmaadhiptigee vdn prtiksseep kllvun vn ovuntt itaa drunnu veednaa gen den dnndduvm aet.
numblaa kRtveedii viy haeki vnu pinnist ohugee niyoogy anuv naev ehi yaatraa krnu pinnist ohugee bhaagyyn numblaa soynu pinnist numblaa venuven muhud vsnng kr dunnee allaahy.
tvd ahshi aeti daae haa mhpollovee aeti daae siyll ohu visin numblaatt ohu vsnng kr dunneey. niyt vshyenm sitiy haeki jnyaatt mehi sNjnyaa aet.
tmn upymin sitti daae heetuven pirisktt prtivipaak pirinaemiim sndhaa allaahgee dnndduvm dinyn apeekssaa nokrnnnhtt smaav dennaeyi vishvaas kllvuntt (nbivry,) ob pvsnu.
kvreku ym yhptk sidu klleed ey ohu venuveni. tvd kvreku npurk sidu kllee d (ey) eytt erehivy. psu v numblaagee prmaadhipti vet numblaa naevt yomu krnu lbnnehuy.
tvd saebaevinm api israaiil druvntt deev grnthy d prjnyaav d nbitvy d pirinaemuvemu. tvd api ovuntt yhpt daeyin poossnn smpt lbaa dunimu. tvd api loovaesiyn atr ovun uss kllemu.

siylu (aagmik) krunnu vl paehaedilitaavn api ovuntt pirinaemuvemu. nmut ovun vet jnyaany paeminnimen psuv ovun atr vuu (iirssyaa shgt) asaadhaarnnkm heetuven mis (vent kisivk sndhaa) ovuhu mtbheed aeti kr gttee naet. ovun mtbheed aeti kr gnimin sitti vissy pillibnd niyt vshyenm obee prmaadhipti mtulovehi vinishcy krnu aet.
psu v em krunn tullin ym pillivetk mt api ob v pt kllemu. eheyin ob ey anugmny krnu. tvd daenumkin tor sittinnngee aashaavn ob anugmny nokrnu.
niyt vshyenm ovun allaahgen vuu kisivkin (ob mudvaa gen) obtt pryojnyk slsnneem naet. tvd niyt vshyenm apraadhkruvn ovungen aetaemeku aetaemekugee bhaarkruvooy. tvd allaah biy baetimtungee bhaarkruy.
mey minis sNhtiy sndhaa vuu paehaedili saadhk veyi. tvd tryee vishvaas krn jnyaatt mg penviimk haa aashirvaadyki.
vishvaas kott yhkm kllvun men paapkm upyaa gt ay ovungee jiivity haa ovungee mrnny api ek smaan les pt krnnemu yaeyi situvoo d? ovun tiindu krn daae npuru viy.
tvd allaah ahs haa mhpollov styyen yutu v maevveey. saaem aatmykm ey upyaa gt daae eytt pirinmnu lbnu aet. tvd ovuhu apraadh krnu nolbti.

(nbivry) kvurun tm mnoobhaavy deviyn bvtt pt kr gtteed. ohuv ob duttuvehi d? daenuvtvm allaah ohu nomg haeriyeey. ohugee svn haa ohugee hdvt mt mudraa taebuveey. ohugee baelm mt aavrnnyk taebuveey. allaahgen psu v ohutt mg penvnuyee kvreku d? numblaa menehi nokrnnehu d?

"mey apgee melov jiivity mis naet. api mrnnytt pt vemu. tvd api jiivt vemu. kaaly mis ven kisivk ap vinaash nokrnu aet" yaeyi ovuhu pvsti. ehet ee pillibnd v ovuntt kisidu daenumk naet. ovuhu anumaan krnu mis naet.
apgee vdn ovun vet paehaedili lesin paaraayny krnu lbn vitt, "numblaa styvaadiin les sittiyehu nm apgee mutun mittn gen enu yaeyi" ovuhu pvsaa sittiyaa mis ovungee saadhky noviiy.

(nbivry) ob pvsnn. allaah numblaa jiivt krvyi, psu v numblaa mrnnytt pt kryi, psu v mllvun keren naegittuvnu lbn diny vet numblaa ekraes kryi, ehi kisidu saekyk naet. nmut jnyaa aturin bhutryk denaa nodniti.
ahs haa mhpollov allaah stuy. em hooraav kriyaatmk vn din, edin astykruvoo praajytt pt veti.
saaem smuuhykm dnnin vaettii sittinu ob dkinu aet. saaem smuuhykm ovungee vaartaav vet aeryum krnu lbti. "ad din numblaa krmin sitti daae sndhaa prtiphl denu lbnnehuy." (yaeyi kiynu laebee.)
mey numblaatt erehi v styyen yutu v ktaa krn apgee vaartaavyi. niyt vshyenm api numblaa sidu krmin sitti daae pillibnd stthn krmin sittiyemu.
vishvaas kott yhkm kllvun vuu klii ovungee prmaadhipti ohugee krunnaav tulltt ovun aetullt krnu aet. eyyi paehaedili jygrhnny vnuyee.
tvd prtiksseep kllvun vuu klii, (ovunhtt) "numblaa vet maagee vdn paaraayny krmin notibunnee d? evitt numblaa uddgu vuuh. tvd numblaa vaerdi krn pirisk vuuh. (yaeyi kiynu laebee.)

"tvd niyt vshyenm allaahgee prtijnyaav saebaaevki. tvd avsn hooraav ehi kisidu saekyk naet" yaeyi kiynu laebuu vitt avsn hooraav kumk daeyi api nodnimu. ey anumaanyk lesin mis api nositmu. tvd api ey tryee vishvaas krnnn novuuyemu yaeyi numblaa paevsuvehuy.
ovun sidu kll daaehi npur ovuntt helli viy. ovun kvr deyk smccl krmin sittiyee d ey ovun vttlaa gtteey.
"numblaagee mem dinyee hmuv numblaa amtk kllaak men ad din api numblaa amtk krnnemu. tvd numblaagee nvaataen (niraa) ginny. tvd numblaatt udvkruvn kisiveku nomaet." yaeyi pvsnu laebee.
"meytt heetuv, niyt vshyenm allaahgee vdn numblaa srdmtt gt baevin haa melov jiivity numblaa mullaa kr aeti baevini." eheyin ad din ovuhu eyin baehaer noveti. tvd ovuhu smaav pillignu lbnnn noveti.

allaahgen tor v numblaa aeryum krn daae des numblaa baeluvehu d? ovun mhpolloven mvaa aettee kumk daeyi mtt numblaa penvnu. esee naethot ahs(maeviime)hi ym hvulk ovuntt tibee d? numblaa styvaadiin les sittiyehu nm miitt per vuu grnthyk hoo jnyaanaanvit slkunnk hoo maa vet gen enu." yaeyi numb pvsnu.
mllvun keren naegittuvnu lbn diny tek allaah haer tmntt pillituru nospyn aytt aeryum krnnaatt vddaa nomg giy ay kvud? tvd movungee aeryum gaen ovuhu vaetthiimk naettooy.
tvd jnyaa ekraes krnu laebuu vitt ovuhu movuntt sturu vnu aet. movungee aedhiim pillibnd v ovuhu prtiksseep krnnn vnu aet.
tvd apgee vdn paehaediliv ovun vet paaraayny krnu laebuvee nm, styy prtiksseep kll ovun, ey em sty ovun vet paeminni klhi "mey paehaedili huuniymk" yaeyi paevsuuh.

esee naethot "ohu ey getuvee yaeyi pvsnnoo d? mm ey getuvee nm allaahgen (vuu dnndduvmin) maa vaellaekviimtt numblaa shktiy nodrnu aet. numblaa kvr krunnk gilii sittinnehu d ee pillibnd v ohu maenvin dnnaay. maa atr haa numb atr saakssikruveku vshyen ohu prmaannvty. tvd ohu atikssmaashiiliiy. asmsm krunnaanvity" yaeyi numb pvsnu.

"dhm duutvrun aturin maa nvkyeku novuuyemi. tvd mtt hoo numblaatt kumk sidu krnu lbnnee daeyi mm nodnimi. maa vet hellidrv krnu lbn daae haer mm nopillipdimi. tvd mm paehaedili avvaad krnneku mis naetae"yi (nbivry) numb pvsnu.

"ey allaah vetin paeminn tibiydiit, israaiil druvn aturin saakssikruvku eytt smaan deyk mt saakssid draa, psu v ohu vishvaas kr sittiy dii numblaa ey prtiksseep kott uddgu vuuyee nm (ee gaen) numblaa kumk sitnnehud? niyt vshyenm allaah apraadhkaarii jnyaatt mg penvnnee naet." yaeyi (nbivry) numb pvsnu.
"ey yhptk vii nm ovuhu ee kerehi aptt idiriyen gos naetaeyi prtiksseep kllvun vishvaas kllvun hmuvee paevsuuh. tvd emgin ovuhu yhmg nolaebuu vitt 'mey puraann prbndhyk' yaeyi ovuhu pvsnu aet.

tvd eytt per mg penvnnk vshyen haa aashirvaadyk vshyen muusaagee grnthy viy. mey araabi bsin vuu (ey) thvuru krn grnthyyi. mey apraadh krnnnhtt avvaad krnu pinnis d daehaemiyntt shubhaarNci dnvnnk pinnis d vee.
'apgee prmaadhipti allaah' yaeyi prkaash kott psuv (ehi) sthaavr v sittiyvun vn ovuntt kisidu biyk naet. emenm ovuhu duktt ptvnnoo d noveti.
ovuhu svrg vaesiyooy. ehi sdaatnikyiny. (ey) ovun sidu krmin sitti daaett prtiphlyk vshyeni.

tvd minisaatt tm demaapiynhtt aep upsthaan krn men api updes dunimu. ohugee mv ohu dusskrtvyen yutu v isiluvaay. tvd dusskrtvyen yutu v aey ohu prsuut kllaay. ohu v (mv kus tull) isiliim haa ohutt kiri vaeriim maas tihki. ohu vaeddi viytt pt v avurudu htllihtt llnngaa vuu vitt "maagee prmaadhiptiyaanneni! numb maa vet haa maagee demvpiyn vet daayaad kll numbgee aashirvaady sndhaa kRtveedii viimttt numb tRptiytt pt vn ayurin daehaemi daae sidu kiriimttt mtt bhaagyy lbaa denu maenv! tvd maagee prpur tull d maahtt daehaemi bv aeti krnu maenv! niyt vshyenm mm paap smaav aeyaed numb vet naemburu vemi. tvd niyt vshyenm mm muslimvrun (allaahtt avnt vnnn) aturini yaeyi ohu paevsuveey.
ovun sidu kll alNkaar daae ovungen ap pilligt ay ovuhumy. tvd api ovungee paapkm nosllkaa hrimu. (ovuhu) svrgvaasiihu atry. (ey) ovuntt prtijnyaa denu lbmin sitti styyee prtijnyaavk vshyeni.

tm demaapiyntt (akiikru vcnyen) 'cii' yaeyi paevsuu keneku "numb dedenaa maa (mini vllen) godd gnu lbnu aetaeyi pvsaa maa biy vddnnehu d? mtt per d prmpraavn ikut v gos aetae"yi paevsiiy. tvd ovun dedenaa allaahgen udv ptmin "numbtt vinaashyyi. numb vishvaas krnu. niyt vshyenm allaahgee prtijnyaav styyki." paevsuu vitt ohu "mey mutun mittngee prbndhyn mis naetae"yi paevsiiy.
tmn vet (dnndduvmee) prkaashy niym vuu ovuhu ovuntt per ikut v giy jinnun haa minisun aturin vuu smuuhyn atry. niyt vshyenm ovuhu praajityin vuuh.
saaem kenekuttm ovun sidu kll daeyin traatirm aet. tvd ovungee kriyaavntt anuv ovuntt puurnn v prtiphl denu aet. tvd ovuhu apraadh sidu krnu nolbti.

tvd prtiksseep kllvun (niraa) ginntt idiript krnu lbn din, numblaagee melov jiivityee dii numblaagee yhpt daae numblaa ivt kr gen aet. tvd numblaa eevaa bhukti vind aet. eheyin ad din numblaa kisidu saadhaarnnykin tor v uddgukm paae heetuven d numblaa paapkm sidukrmin sitti heetuven d nindit dnndduvm prtiphl vshyen denu lbnnehuy.

tvd aadgee shoodryaa ahkaafhi (vaelikndu mt) sitt tm jnyaatt avvaad kll avsthaav numb menehi krnu. ohutt per d ohutt psu d mevn avvaad krnnn ikut v gos aet. "allaah haer numblaa (vent kisivkutt) gaetikm nokrnu. niyt vshyenm mht vuu dinyk dnndduvm numblaa vet paeminniim gaen niyt vshyenm mm biy vemi" (yaeyi ohu paevsiiy).
"apgee devivrungen ap ventktt yomu kiriim sndhaa numb ap vet paeminniyehi d? esee nm, numb styvaadiin aturin keneku vii nm numb aptt prtijnyaa den daae ap vet gen enu" yaeyi ovuhu paevsuuh.
"niyt vshyenm em daenum allaah abiysy. tvd kvr deyk smg maa evnu laebuvee d ey maa numblaatt daenum demi. nmut numblaa vtthaa nognnaa pirisk les mm numblaa dkimi" yaeyi ohu paevsiiy.

ovungee mittiyaavt destt ey vlaakullk see llnngaa vnu ovuhu duttu klhi, "mey aptt vaesi gen den vlaakullki" yaeyi ovuhu paevsuuh. "esee nov, ey numblaa kvr deyk ikmnnin paetuvehu d eyyi. daeddi sullgki. ehi veedniiy dnndduvmk aet."

"ey ehi prmaadhiptigee niyoogy anuv siylu daae sunu visunu krnu aet." evitt ovungee vaassthaan haer (kisiveku) dkinntt nolbn tttvytt ovuhu pt vuuh. apraadhkaarii jnyaatt api prtivipaak pirinmnuyee elesy.

kvr vissyk api numblaatt phsukm lbaa nodunnemu d evn daaehi saebaevinm api ovuntt phsukm lbaa dunimu. tvd api ovuntt svn, baelm haa hdvt d aeti kllemu. nmut allaahgee vdn ovun prtiksseep krmin sitti baevin ovungee svn hoo ovungee baelm hoo ovungee hdvt kisivkin hoo ovuntt phlk noviiy. tvd ovun kvr deyk pillibnd smccl krmin sittiyee d ey ovun vttkrgtteey.
tvd numblaa avtt pihitti gmmaan (raashiyk) saebaevinm api vinaash kllemu. ovun naevt yomu viy haeki vnu pinnis em sNjnyaa api vividhaakaaryen gen haer paaevemu.
allaahtt amtr v smiipviimee maargyk les ovun gt (vent) devivrun ovuntt udv kr tibiy yutu novee d? esee novee. ovuhu ovungen mullaa vii aet. tvd ey ovungee boruvy. tvd ovun gotmin sitti daaey.

ap numb vet al kuraany svn denntt jin vrgyaagen pirisk yomu kll avsthaav sihipt krnu. evitt ovun ohu vet paeminni klhi "numblaa nihnndd v svn denu" yaeyi ovuhu paevsuuh. psu v (paaraayny)avsn vuu klhi ovuhu tm smuuhyaa vet avvaad krnnn les haerii giyh.
ahoo apgee jnyini! muusaagen psu v, (eytt per) tmn atr paevti daae thvuru krmin phll krn ld deev grnthyktt niyt vshyenm api svn dunimu. ey styy vet haa Rju maargy vet mg penvnu aet.
"ahoo apgee jnyini! allaahgee kaendvumkrutt numblaa prticaar dkvnu. tvd numblaa ohu vishvaas krnu. numblaagee paapyntt ohu numblaatt smaav denneey. tvd veedniiy dnndduvmin ohu numblaa mudvaa gnneey.
"tvd, kvreku allaahgee kaendvumkrutt prticaar nodkvnnee d evitt ohu mhpollovee (allaahv abibvaa ynntt) haekiyaav aettek novee. tvd ohugen tor v ohutt aarksskyek nomaet. ovuhu paehaedili mullaavehiy.

niyt vshyenm ahs haa mhpollov mvaa, eevaa maeviimen niraayaasytt pt novuu allaah mllvuntt ylli jiivy denntt shktiy aettaa bv ovuhu noduttuvoo d? eseey niyt vshyenm ohu siylu daae kerehi shktiy aettaay.

tvd prtiksseep kllvun (niraa) ginn vet idiript krnu lbn dinyee "mey styy novee d" (yaeyi vimsnu lbti). "apgee prmaadhipti mt divuraa (ey) eseey" yaeyi ovuhu pvsti. "esee nm numblaa prtiksseep krmin sitti daae heetuven em dnndduvm numblaa bhukti vindinu" yaeyi ohu pvsyi.

eheyin dhm duutvrun aturin daeddi adhisstthaanyen vuuvn ivsuvaak men numb d ivsnu. tvd ovun sndhaa numb ikmn novnu. ovuntt prtijnyaa denu laebuu daae ovun dkin din dhvl kaalyee hooraavk mis tmn ntr novuuvaak meni. (numbee kaaryy) daenum diimki. paaptr jnyaa haer (vent kisiveku) vinaash krnu lbnneed?

eheyin prtiksseep kllvun numblaa (yud bimee) hmu vuu vitt (ovungee) gelvl vettt phr denu. avsaanyee numblaa ovun abhibhvny kr gt vitt yuddhy tm aayudh bim tbn tek (ovun) grhnny kiriim numblaa tdinm sidu krnu. ey psu anugrh daekviimk hoo vndi lbaa gaeniimk viy haek. mey (allaahgee niyoogy) vee. allaah abhimt krnnee nm ovungen ohum vipaakphly gnu aet. nmut (ohu esee sidu nokllee) numblaagen aetaemek aetaemeku visin ohu priikssaavtt pt krnu pinnisy. tvd allaahgee maargyee ghaatny krnu laebuuvn vnaahi ovungee kriyaavn ahimi vii ynntt ohu idd hrinnee naet.
ohu ovuntt mtu mg penvnu aet. tvd ovungee tttvyn ohu vidhimt krnu aet.

vishvaas kott yhkm kllvun, eevaatt phllin gNgaa glaa bsnaa (svrg) uyn vltt niyt vshyenm allaah aetullt kryi. tvd prtiksseep kllvun vn ovuhu (dnndduvm) bhukti vinditi. tvd (molov bhukti vindinnn) govipll stun anubhv krnnaak men anubhv krti. tvd (niraa) ginn ovuntt himi nvaataenyi.
numb v pittmN kll obee gmmaanytt vddaa, vddaat blvt vuu gmmaan kopmnnk api vinaash kllemud? evitt ovuntt kisidu udvkruveku noviiy.
tm prmaadhiptigen vuu paehaedili saadhk mt sittinnaa, tm npuru kriyaav ohutt alNkaar kr penvnu laeb tm aashaavn anugmny kll ay men d?

biy baetimtunhtt prtijnyaa denu laebuu svrgyee svbhaavy nm, ehi pl novn jlyen yut gNgaa d, ehi rsy vens novn kiri paanyen yut gNgaa d, paany krnnnhtt rsvt mudrikpaanyen yut gNgaa d, pirisidu krn ld mii paenniyen yut gNgaa d aet. tvd ovuntt ehi siylu plturu d, ovungee prmaadhiptigen vuu smaav d aet. ohu (niraa) ginnee sdaatnikyeku men d? tvd (evn niraavaasiin vn) ovuntt loo diy povnu laebee. evitt ey ovungee bddvael kaebli kryi.

tvd ovun aturin numb vet svn dennn d veti. numb vetin ovun pitt v giy vitt mohu mohotktt per kumk paevsuvee dae?yi jnyaany denu laebuuvntt ovuhu (smcclyen yutu v) vimsti. tm hdvt mt allaah mudraa taebuu haa tm aashaavn anugmny kllvun movuhumy.
tvd yhmg laebuuvn vn ovunhtt ohu yhmg adhik klleey. tvd ohu ovuntt ovungee biy baetimtkm pirinmnu aet.
avsn hooraav esaennin ovun vet paeminniim mis venekk ovuhu blaaporottu vnnehu d? saebaevinm ehi slkunnu paeminn aet. esee nm ovun vet ovungee updes paeminni vitt kesee nm ovuntt (phlk) vet d?

eheyin daen gnu. niyt vshyenm allaah haer vent devindeku naet. obee paapynttt deev vishvaaskrnnn haa deev vishvaaskrnniynhttt smaav ayaedinu. tvd allaah numblaagee kriyaakaarkm haa numblaagee nvaataen dnii.

(yuddhy smbndh v) suurtyk (priccheedyk) phll krnu laebiy yutu novee dae?yi vishvaas kllvun vimsti. nmut tiirnnaatmk suurtyk phll krnu laeb ehi yuddhy smbndh v sndhn krnu laebuu vitt tm hdvt tull roog aettvun mrnny tmn vet vellaa gt keneku sihi naetivii blnnaak men numb vet ovuhu blti. eheyin ovuntt (vinaashy) vddaat yoogyy.

numblaatt (yuddhy) pittupaaemtt bly denu laebuvee nm, mhpollovee numblaa klhkm sidu kott numblaagee jnyaatii smbndhkm bind hellnntt taet krnnehu d?
